.radio-toggle{appearance:none;position:relative;float:left;box-sizing:border-box;width:60px;height:34px;margin:1px 0;padding:0 5px 0 31px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:#e3dfd5;color:#665f52;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px #0002;font:bold 11px/34px Arial;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;}
.radio-toggle::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:4.5px;left:4.5px;width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff3ba;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #888;transition:transform .15s;}
.radio-toggle[aria-pressed=true]{padding:0 31px 0 5px;background:#fff;color:#62430f;}
.radio-toggle[aria-pressed=true]::after{transform:translateX(26px);}
.radio-toggle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #aa7e25;outline-offset:2px;}
div.radio-group:not(.Fcht)>label:nth-last-child(1 of label:not([style*="display:none"],[style*="display: none"])){border-top-right-radius:999px;border-bottom-right-radius:999px;}

.tooltip-overlay {position:fixed;top: 0;left: 0;width: 100%;height: 100%;background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);z-index: 998;cursor: zoom-out;}
.tooltip-content {display:none;position: fixed;top: 50%;left: 50%;width: 680px;min-height: 120px;background: #fff;color: #000;padding: 20px;border-radius: 8px;box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);font-size: 14px;z-index: 999;transform: translate(-50%, -50%);box-sizing: border-box;max-height:calc(100vh - 16px);overflow:auto;}

@media (pointer:coarse) {.tooltip-content > .tooltip-drag-bar {height:44px;}.tooltip-content > .tooltip-drag-bar > .tooltip-close {flex-basis:44px;width:44px;height:43px;line-height:43px;}}

/* ▼ボタンを必ず均等割り（2個でも3個でも余りなし） */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap{
  width:240px;                 /* 全体幅：25%狭めた値（必要なら微調整） */
  display:grid !important;
  grid-auto-flow:column;
  grid-auto-columns:1fr;
  margin:0 !important;
}
/* ボタンはセルいっぱいに伸ばす */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button{
  width:100% !important;
  min-width:0 !important;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding:8px 0;               /* 横paddingを0にして“等分感”を揃える（好みで 8px 6px でもOK） */
  text-align:center;
}
/* 区切り線（固定なし｜上部固定｜下部固定 すべてに線が入る） */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button + button{
  border-left:1px solid #555;
}
/* activeで border-color を青に変える既存指定がある場合の保険 */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button.is-active{
  border-left-color:#555;
}
/* ラベルをボタンの左に“同じ高さ”で並べる（強制） */
.toggleGrid{
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 140px 240px; /* 左:ラベル幅 / 右:ボタン群幅（25%狭めた幅） */
  column-gap:8px;
  row-gap:10px;
  align-items:center;
  justify-items:start;
}
.toggleGridLabel{
  text-align:left !important;
  justify-self:start;
  margin:0 !important;
  padding:0 !important;
  line-height:1.1;
}
/* 右側（ボタン群）を行頭に固定 */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap{
  margin:0 !important;
  justify-self:start;
}

/* ===== フッター設定パネル レスポンシブ ===== */
@media (max-width: 600px){
  /* 外側テーブル: 固定幅を解除 */
  .footTBL{
    width:100% !important;
    margin-left:0 !important;
  }

  /* 内側テーブルをフレックス縦積みに変換 */
  #footTBLtd1 > table {padding-top:20px;}
  #footTBLtd1 > table,
  #footTBLtd1 > table > tbody{
    display:flex !important;
    flex-direction:column;
    width:100%;
  }
  #footTBLtd1 > table > tbody > tr{
    display:contents;  /* trを消して td を直接フレックスアイテムに */
  }
  #footTBLtd1 > table > tbody > tr > td{
    display:block;
    width:100% !important;
    padding:4px 8px !important;
  }
  /* toggleGrid の td を一番上に移動 */
  #footTBLtd1 > table > tbody > tr:first-child > td:last-child{
    order:-1;
    padding-bottom:8px !important;
    text-align:center;
  }
  /* cookie削除メッセージ */
  #footTBLtd1 > table > tbody > tr:first-child > td:first-child{
    order:0;

  }
  /* copyright */
  #footTBLtd1 > table > tbody > tr:nth-child(2) > td{
    order:1;
    text-align:center;
  }

  /* toggleGrid 自体を1列縦積みに */
  .toggleGrid{
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    row-gap:6px;
    display:inline-grid !important;
    width:auto;
    width:480px;
  }
  .toggleGridLabel{
    font-size:12px;
    color:#765;
    margin-bottom:-4px !important;
  }
  .toggleGrid .toggle-wrap{
    width:100% !important;
    max-width:100%;
  }
  .toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button{
    font-size:12px;
    padding:7px 0;
  }
  .toggleGrid .toggle-wrap select{
    font-size:13px !important;
    padding:6px 4px !important;
  }
}

/* ===== FloatMenu (#topmenu) 3パターン：下部固定が必ず効く版（重複なし） ===== */
:root{
  --sb-body-left: 0px;
  --sb-body-width: 100vw;
  --sb-topmenu-h: 62px;
  --sb-anchor-h: 0px;
  --sb-anchor-bottom-h: 0px;  /* 下側アンカー専用 */
}

/* 固定なし：.fixed が付いても殺す（強制上書き） */
html.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu,
html.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu.fixed,
body.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu,
body.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu.fixed{
  position: static !important;
  top: auto !important;
  bottom: auto !important;
  left: auto !important;
  right: auto !important;
  width: auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  z-index:auto !important;
}
/* 上部固定：通常時は自然配置へ戻す（既存CSSがfixedでも事故らない） */
html.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu,
body.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu{
  position: static !important;
  top:auto !important;
  bottom:auto !important;
  left:auto !important;
  right:auto !important;
  width:auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  z-index:auto !important;
}
/* 上部固定：.fixed の時だけ固定（スクロール閾値ロジック維持） */
html.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu.fixed,
body.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu.fixed{
  position: fixed !important;
  top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) !important;
  bottom: auto !important;
  left: var(--sb-body-left) !important;
  width: var(--sb-body-width) !important;
  right: auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  box-sizing:border-box !important;
  z-index:999999 !important;
}
/* 下部固定：常時固定（ここが本命：top を必ず殺す） */
html.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu,
html.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu.fixed,
body.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu,
body.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu.fixed{
  position: fixed !important;
  top: auto !important; /* ← これが残ると下に行かない */
  /* bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + var(--sb-anchor-h)) !important; */
  bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + var(--sb-anchor-bottom-h)) !important;
  left: var(--sb-body-left) !important;
  width: var(--sb-body-width) !important;
  right: auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  box-sizing:border-box !important;
  z-index:999999 !important;
}
/* 下部固定時：本文が隠れないように下余白（anchor-h=0でもOK） */
html.fmBottom body,
body.fmBottom{
  /* padding-bottom: calc(var(--sb-topmenu-h) + var(--sb-anchor-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important; */
  padding-bottom: calc(var(--sb-topmenu-h) + var(--sb-anchor-bottom-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
}

/* 従来型の複合チャート用。ページ固有の系列・Cookie・期間は各JSに残す。 */
function nkCreateCompositeController(key,getChart,interval){
    var mode=-1,generation=0,requests=[],poll=null,ready=false;
    function cancel(){
        generation++;
        if(poll){poll.stop();poll=null;}
        var old=requests;requests=[];old.forEach(function(request){request.abort();});
    }
    window.addEventListener('marketupdatesstop',cancel);
    return {
        begin:function(nextMode){cancel();mode=Number(nextMode);ready=false;},
        ajax:function(options){
            var token=generation;
            if(typeof options.timeout==='undefined')options.timeout=12000;
            var request=$.ajax(options),rawDone=request.done,rawFail=request.fail;
            requests.push(request);
            request.always(function(){var i=requests.indexOf(request);if(i>=0)requests.splice(i,1);});
            function guard(fn){return function(){if(token===generation)return fn.apply(this,arguments);};}
            request.done=function(fn){if(typeof fn==='function')rawDone.call(request,guard(fn));return request;};
            request.fail=function(fn){if(typeof fn==='function')rawFail.call(request,guard(fn));return request;};
            return request;
        },
        start:function(load,initialize){
            if(poll)poll.stop();
            // 自動更新停止後も、利用者が選んだ期間の初回表示は実行する。
            if(window.nkMarketUpdatesAllowed&&!nkMarketUpdatesAllowed()){
                initialize();return {stop:cancel};
            }
            poll=nkStartMarketPoll(key,function(){
                if(mode!==2||requests.length)return $.Deferred().resolve().promise();
                if(!ready||!getChart()){
                    var token=generation,request=initialize();
                    request.done(function(){if(token===generation&&getChart())ready=true;});
                    return request;
                }
                return load();
            },interval);
            return poll;
        },
        version:function(){return generation;},
        mode:function(){return mode;}
    };

/* タブが5分以上隠れていたらWebSocketを切り、表示に戻ったらつなぎ直す。
   タブを大量に開くと接続がブラウザの上限まで貯まり、新しいページの通信が待たされるため。
   socket.ioが window.io を設定した時点で包み、作られたソケットを覚えておく。
   head5 と ssi_11_head の両方に同じ処理があり、先に読まれた方だけ動く。 */
(function(w,d){
    if(w.nkSocketIdleInstalled)return;
    w.nkSocketIdleInstalled=true;
    var IDLE_MS=5*60*1000,sockets=[],timer=0,current=w.io;
    function wrap(io){
        if(typeof io!=='function'||io._nkIdleWrapped)return io;
        var wrapped=function(){
            var socket=io.apply(this,arguments);
            if(socket&&typeof socket.disconnect==='function'&&typeof socket.connect==='function'){
                // ページ側で切って作り直した古いソケットは覚えておかない。
                sockets=sockets.filter(function(s){return s.active||s._nkIdle;});
                sockets.push(socket);
            }
            return socket;
        };
        for(var key in io)if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(io,key))wrapped[key]=io[key];
        wrapped._nkIdleWrapped=true;
        return wrapped;
    }
    try{
        current=wrap(current);
        Object.defineProperty(w,'io',{configurable:true,enumerable:true,get:function(){return current;},set:function(value){current=wrap(value);}});
    }catch(e){return;}
    function sleep(){
        timer=0;
        if(!d.hidden)return;
        // ページ側で切ったソケット(active=false)は触らない。
        sockets=sockets.filter(function(socket){return socket.active||socket._nkIdle;});
        sockets.forEach(function(socket){
            if(!socket.active)return;
            socket._nkIdle=true;
            try{socket.disconnect();}catch(e){}
        });
    }
    function wake(){
        if(timer){clearTimeout(timer);timer=0;}
        var woke=false;
        sockets.forEach(function(socket){
            if(!socket._nkIdle)return;
            socket._nkIdle=false;woke=true;
            try{socket.connect();}catch(e){}
        });
        // 切断中の値はSocketで補えないため、チャートを作り直すページへ知らせる。
        if(woke)try{w.dispatchEvent(new Event('nksocketwake'));}catch(e){}
    }
    d.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){
        if(d.hidden){if(!timer)timer=setTimeout(sleep,IDLE_MS);}
        else wake();
    });
    w.addEventListener('pageshow',function(){if(!d.hidden)wake();});

<script>
(function (global) {
  function buildEvents() {
    // EVE が正しく配列で入っているかチェック
    if (!global.EVE || !global.EVE.length) return;

    var eveDiv = document.getElementById("eveDIV");
    if (!eveDiv) return;

    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

    for (var i = 0; i < global.EVE.length; i++) {
      var line = global.EVE[i];
      if (!line) continue;

      var p = line.split("_");
      if (p.length < 5) continue;

      var time = p[0];             // 14:00 or 12/10 など
      var cat1 = p[1];             // 株式市場
      var cat2 = p[2];             // 後場OPEN
      var area = p[3];             // タグが入っていてもOK
      var slug = (p[4] || "").trim();  // china or ""

      // デイリーデータ判定（時間に / が入っているか）
      var isDaily = (time.indexOf("/") !== -1);

      var eve = document.createElement("div");
      eve.className = isDaily ? "eve day" : "eve";

      var tt = document.createElement("tt");
      tt.textContent = time;
      eve.appendChild(tt);
      eve.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" "));

      var span = document.createElement("span");
      span.className = "eve2";

      // 「市場休日」が入っていたら eve2 holiday にする
      var hay = [cat1, cat2, area].join(" ");
      if (hay.indexOf("市場休日") !== -1) {
        span.className += " holiday";
      }

      var html = "";

      if (slug) {
        var url = "//nikkei225jp.com/" + encodeURIComponent(slug) + "/";
        html += '<a href="' + url + '" target="_self">' + area + '</a>';
      } else {
        html += area;
      }
      html += " " + cat1 + " " + cat2;

      span.innerHTML = html; // タグをエスケープしない
      eve.appendChild(span);
      frag.appendChild(eve);
    }

    eveDiv.appendChild(frag);
  }

  // DOM と EVE が揃うまで少しだけ待つ
  var retry = 0;
  var maxRetry = 50;

  function tryBuild() {
    if (global.EVE && global.EVE.length && document.getElementById("eveDIV")) {
      buildEvents();
    } else if (retry < maxRetry) {
      retry++;
      setTimeout(tryBuild, 100);
    } else {
      // ここまで来たら EVE が定義されていないか eveDIV が無い想定
      if (global.console && console.warn) {
        console.warn("EVE events not built (EVE or eveDIV missing)");
      }
    }
  }

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(tryBuild);
})(window);

<script>
(function (global) {

  // -----------------------------
  // パース系
  // -----------------------------
  function parseLine(line) {
    if (typeof line !== "string" || !line) return null;
    var parts = line.split("_");
    if (parts.length < 7) return null;

    var id       = parts[0];
    var perStr   = parts[1] || "0";
    var colClass = parts[2] || "";
    var path     = parts[3] || "/";
    var nameParts = parts.slice(4, parts.length - 2);
    var name      = nameParts.join("_");
    var time      = parts[parts.length - 2] || "";
    var ttRaw     = parseInt(parts[parts.length - 1], 10);
    var ttype     = isNaN(ttRaw) ? 0 : ttRaw;
    var per       = parseFloat(perStr) || 0;

    return {
      id: id,
      per: per,
      perStr: perStr,
      colClass: colClass,
      path: path,
      name: name,
      time: time,
      ttype: ttype
    };
  }

  function parseLines(list) {
    var out = [];
    if (!list || typeof list.length === "undefined") return out;
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      var obj = parseLine(list[i]);
      if (obj) out.push(obj);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // 背景色計算
  // -----------------------------
  function getBgColor(val, e) {
    // Color.js の保存済み配色を優先。未読込のページは従来色を使用する。
    if (typeof global.colGetPer2BG === "function") {
      return global.colGetPer2BG(val, e);
    }

    var RITU  = 98;
    var BASE  = 90;
    var BASE2 = 100;
    var MAX   = 225;

    var a = Number(val);
    if (!isFinite(a)) a = 0;

    var scale = 1;
    if (e !== undefined && e !== null && e !== 0) {
      scale = 1 / e;
    }

    if (Math.abs(a) / scale < 0.0001) {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    }

    var n = Math.round(RITU * Math.abs(a) * scale + BASE2);
    if (n > MAX) n = MAX;

    if (a > 0) {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + n + "," + BASE + ")";
    } else if (a < 0) {
      return "rgb(" + n + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    } else {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // DOM に描画
  // -----------------------------
  function build(list, isUp, box) {
    if (!box) return;

    var items = parseLines(list);
    if (!items.length) return;

    // 既存の a.UpdwArap を削除
    var olds = box.querySelectorAll("a.UpdwArap");
    for (var i = 0; i < olds.length; i++) {
      var el = olds[i];
      if (el && el.parentNode) {
        el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
      }
    }

    var arrowText = isUp ? "▲" : "▼";

    for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) {
      var it = items[j];

      var href = "//nikkei225jp.com" + (it.path || "/");

      // <a>
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.className = "UpdwArap";
      a.href = href;
      a.target = "_self";

      // パーセント表示部分
      var c = document.createElement("div");
      c.className = "UpDwC";
      // 配色変更時に背景だけ更新できるよう、符号付きの変化率を保持する。
      c.setAttribute("data-side-rank-per", String(it.per));
      c.style.background = getBgColor(it.per, 3);

      var arrow = document.createElement("span");
      arrow.className = "alw";
      arrow.appendChild(document.createTextNode(arrowText));

      var pct = document.createElement("span");
      pct.className = "sm50";
      pct.appendChild(document.createTextNode("%"));

      c.appendChild(arrow);
      c.appendChild(document.createTextNode(Math.abs(it.per || 0).toFixed(2)));
      c.appendChild(pct);
      a.appendChild(c);

      // 名前部分
      var udnm = document.createElement("span");
      udnm.className = "UDnm";

      var col = document.createElement("span");
      col.className = it.colClass || "";

      var nameSpan = document.createElement("span");
      nameSpan.innerHTML = it.name || ""; // 元が .html(it.name) なので innerHTML

      udnm.appendChild(col);
      udnm.appendChild(nameSpan);
      a.appendChild(udnm);

      // 時刻部分
      var timeClass = (it.ttype === 1) ? "timUD1" : "timUD0";
      var timeSpan = document.createElement("span");
      timeSpan.className = timeClass;
      timeSpan.appendChild(document.createTextNode(it.time));
      a.appendChild(timeSpan);

      box.appendChild(a);
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // DOM Ready
  // -----------------------------
  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(function () {
    var upBox = document.getElementById("UpdwU");
    var dwBox = document.getElementById("UpdwD");
    if (!upBox && !dwBox) return;

    // HTML で読み込まれたグローバル変数を利用
    var upList = global.PERup;
    var dwList = global.PERdw;

    if (upList && upBox) {
      build(upList, true, upBox);
    }
    if (dwList && dwBox) {
      build(dwList, false, dwBox);
    }
  });

  // データの再取得や一覧の作り直しをせず、配色変更を即時反映する。
  global.addEventListener("trendcolorchange", function () {
    var badges = document.querySelectorAll("#sideRANK .UpDwC[data-side-rank-per]");
    for (var i = 0; i < badges.length; i++) {
      var value = Number(badges[i].getAttribute("data-side-rank-per"));
      badges[i].style.background = getBgColor(value, 3);
    }
  });

})(window);

(function(w,d){

function getWidthPx(el){return Math.round(parseFloat(w.getComputedStyle(el).width));}
function place(from,parent,before){

		appendTo('bottom', 'content');
		appendTo('footGlink', 'footLinkTd');
		lastView = 'PC';
	}
	} finally { repairParentsOnly = false; }

	return true;
}

function updateBodyVars(){
    var base=d.getElementById('body1')||d.body;if(!base)return;
    var r=base.getBoundingClientRect(),menu=d.getElementById('topmenu');
    if(r.width<=0)return;

function applyClasses(){

}

    applyClasses();resizeWIN();
}
function resizeWIN(){
    /* 初回同期配置は維持。非表示中の更新は復帰後へ回す。 */
    if(d.hidden&&w.nkLayoutReady)return false;
    if(!moveLayout())return false;
    updateFixed();updateBodyVars();
    if(!w.nkLayoutReady){
        d.querySelectorAll('a.highslide').forEach(function(el){el.setAttribute('data-google-interstitial','false');});
        w.nkLayoutReady=true;
        d.dispatchEvent(new Event('nklayoutready'));
    }
    return true;
}
var requestUpdate=nkFrameOnce(resizeWIN);
var requestPositionUpdate=nkFrameOnce(function(){if(!d.hidden){updateFixed();updateBodyVars();}});
w.resizeWIN=resizeWIN;
w.nkLayout={setAlign:setAlign,setFloat:setFloat,reset:reset,update:resizeWIN,requestUpdate:requestUpdate};
w.addEventListener('resize',requestUpdate);
w.addEventListener('pageshow',requestUpdate);
w.addEventListener('focus',requestUpdate);
w.addEventListener('orientationchange',requestUpdate);
d.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){if(!d.hidden)requestUpdate();});
if(smallScreen){
    if(smallScreen.addEventListener)smallScreen.addEventListener('change',requestUpdate);
    else if(smallScreen.addListener)smallScreen.addListener(requestUpdate);
}
/* Safariのツールバー・拡大縮小による表示領域の変化にも追従する。
   配置はあくまで上のCSSメディアクエリで決定する。 */
if(w.visualViewport){
    w.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',requestUpdate);
    w.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll',requestPositionUpdate,{passive:true});
}
w.addEventListener('scroll',requestPositionUpdate,{passive:true});
resizeWIN();

// deleteAllCookies
function deleteAllCookies(silent) {
	const currentPath=location.pathname.replace(/[^/]*$/, "");
	const paths=Array.from(new Set(["/",currentPath,currentPath.replace(/\/$/, ""),"/"+(typeof pageName!=="undefined"?pageName:"")]));
	const cookies = document.cookie.split(";");
	for (const cookie of cookies) {
		const eqPos = cookie.indexOf("=");
		const name = eqPos > -1 ? cookie.substr(0, eqPos).trim() : cookie.trim();
		for (const path of paths) {
		document.cookie = `${name}=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT;path=${path}`;
		}
	}
	if(silent!==true)alert("このページのクッキーを削除しました。");
}


// WorldTime
const nkWorldTimeFormatters = {
	"Asia/Tokyo": new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23"}),
	"America/New_York": new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone:"America/New_York",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23"})
};
const nkWorldDateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ja-JP", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",year:"numeric",month:"2-digit",day:"2-digit"});
const nkWorldWeekdayFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ja-JP", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",weekday:"long"});
const nkWorldWeekdayEnFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",weekday:"short"});
function updateTime(targetId, timeZone) {
	const now = new Date();
	// "JST" を指定した場合も、PCのローカル時刻ではなく東京時刻を使う
	const resolvedTimeZone = (timeZone === "JST") ? "Asia/Tokyo" : timeZone;
	const formatter = nkWorldTimeFormatters[resolvedTimeZone];
	if(!formatter) return;
	const timeParts = formatter.formatToParts(now);
	const hour = Number(timeParts.find((part) => part.type === "hour").value);
	const minute = timeParts.find((part) => part.type === "minute").value;
	const formattedTime = `${String(hour).padStart(2, "0")}:${minute}`;

	if (resolvedTimeZone === "Asia/Tokyo") {
		const formattedDate = nkWorldDateFormatter.format(now);
		const formattedDay = nkWorldWeekdayFormatter.format(now);

		const dateElem = d.getElementById("WtimeT");
		if (dateElem) dateElem.textContent = formattedDate;
		const wElem = d.getElementById("WtimeW");
		if (wElem) {
			wElem.textContent = formattedDay;
			const day = nkWorldWeekdayEnFormatter.format(now);
			if (day === "Sun") {
				wElem.style.color = "#f77";   // 日曜
			} else if (day === "Sat") {
				wElem.style.color = "#69f";  // 土曜
			} else {
				wElem.style.color = "";
			}
		}
	}
	const timeColor = getTimeColor(hour);
	const targetEl = d.getElementById(targetId);
	if (targetEl) {
		targetEl.textContent = formattedTime;
		targetEl.style.color = timeColor;
	}
}

function getTimeColor(hour) {
	if (hour >= 7 && hour < 9) {
		return "#6c0";
	} else if (hour >= 9 && hour < 17) {
		return "#da5";
	} else if (hour >= 17 && hour < 20) {
		return "#47a";
	} else {
		return "#999";
	}
}

let nkScheduleDateKey = '';
function updateWorldTime(forceDateRefresh) {
	updateTime("timeJP", "Asia/Tokyo");
	updateTime("timeNY", "America/New_York");
	refreshScheduleDateClasses(!!forceDateRefresh);
}
let nkWorldTimeTimer = 0, nkWorldResumeTimer = 0, nkWorldStarted = false, nkWorldLastResume = 0;
function scheduleWorldTime(){
	if(nkWorldTimeTimer){clearTimeout(nkWorldTimeTimer);nkWorldTimeTimer=0;}
	if(d.hidden||!nkWorldStarted) return;
	let delay=60050-(Date.now()%60000);
	nkWorldTimeTimer=setTimeout(function(){nkWorldTimeTimer=0;updateWorldTime(false);scheduleWorldTime();},delay);
}
function stopWorldTime(){
	if(nkWorldTimeTimer){clearTimeout(nkWorldTimeTimer);nkWorldTimeTimer=0;}
	if(nkWorldResumeTimer){clearTimeout(nkWorldResumeTimer);nkWorldResumeTimer=0;}
}
function resumeWorldTime(){
	if(d.hidden||!nkWorldStarted||nkWorldResumeTimer)return;
	nkWorldResumeTimer=setTimeout(function(){
		nkWorldResumeTimer=0;
		if(d.hidden||!nkWorldStarted)return;
		const now=Date.now();
		if(nkWorldTimeTimer&&now-nkWorldLastResume<1000){startScheduleDateObserver();return;}
		nkWorldLastResume=now;
		updateWorldTime(true);scheduleWorldTime();startScheduleDateObserver();
	},0);
}

// modern-tooltip replacement for dhtmltooltip
let mTooltip, isTooltipVisible = false, lastMouseX = 0, lastMouseY = 0;
const nkPositionTooltip=nkFrameOnce(function(){positionTooltipCoords(lastMouseX,lastMouseY);});
nkOnReady(() => {
	mTooltip = d.createElement("div");
	mTooltip.id = "modernTooltip";
	mTooltip.className = "modern-tooltip";
	d.body.appendChild(mTooltip);
});
d.addEventListener("mousemove", (evt) => {
	lastMouseX = evt.clientX;
	lastMouseY = evt.clientY;
	if (isTooltipVisible) {
		nkPositionTooltip();
	}
});
window.addEventListener("mouseout", (evt) => {
	if (!evt.relatedTarget) hideTooltip();
});
function showTooltip(htmlContent) {
	if (!mTooltip) return;
	mTooltip.innerHTML = htmlContent;
	mTooltip.classList.add("visible");
	isTooltipVisible = true;
	nkPositionTooltip();
}
function hideTooltip() {
	if (!mTooltip) return;
	mTooltip.classList.remove("visible");
	isTooltipVisible = false;
}
function positionTooltipCoords(clientX, clientY) {
	if (!isTooltipVisible || !mTooltip) return;
	const padding = 10;
	const scrollX = window.scrollX || window.pageXOffset;
	const scrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
	const rect = mTooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
	const winW = window.innerWidth;
	const winH = window.innerHeight;
	let left = clientX + padding;
	let top = clientY + padding;
	if (left + rect.width > winW) {
		left = clientX - rect.width - padding;
		if (left < 0) left = padding;
	}
	if (top + rect.height > winH) {
		top = clientY - rect.height - padding;
		if (top < 0) top = padding;
	}
	mTooltip.style.left = `${left + scrollX}px`;
	mTooltip.style.top = `${top + scrollY}px`;
}

/* tooltip  replacement for micromodal */
nkOnReady(() => {
	const contents = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip-content'));
	const overlay = d.getElementById('overlay');
	const initialPositions = new WeakMap();
	let activeContent = null, drag = null;
	function placeContent(content, left, top, rect) {
		const margin = 8;
		// 固定幅ページを縮小表示するスマホでは clientWidth と表示範囲が異なる。
		const viewport = window.visualViewport;
		const width = viewport ? viewport.width : window.innerWidth;
		const height = viewport ? viewport.height : window.innerHeight;
		const minLeft = (viewport ? viewport.offsetLeft : 0) + margin;
		const minTop = (viewport ? viewport.offsetTop : 0) + margin;
		left = Math.max(minLeft, Math.min(left, Math.max(minLeft, minLeft + width - rect.width - margin * 2)));
		top = Math.max(minTop, Math.min(top, Math.max(minTop, minTop + height - rect.height - margin * 2)));
		// CSS zoom が指定されたページでも、画面上の座標を二重に縮小しない。
		const cssWidth = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(content).width);
		const scale = content.currentCSSZoom || (cssWidth > 0 ? rect.width / cssWidth : 1) || 1;
		content.style.transform = 'none';
		content.style.left = left / scale + 'px';
		content.style.top = top / scale + 'px';
		return {left, top};
	}
	function endDrag(evt) {
		if (!drag || (evt && evt.pointerId !== undefined && evt.pointerId !== drag.pointerId)) return;
		const finished = drag;
		drag = null;
		finished.content.classList.remove('tooltip-dragging');
		d.removeEventListener('pointermove', moveDrag);
		d.removeEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
		d.removeEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
		if (finished.handle.hasPointerCapture(finished.pointerId)) {
			finished.handle.releasePointerCapture(finished.pointerId);
		}
	}
	function moveDrag(evt) {
		if (!drag || evt.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
		const dx = evt.clientX - drag.x, dy = evt.clientY - drag.y;
		// タップや指先のわずかな揺れでは、中央表示から位置を切り替えない。
		if (!drag.moved && Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) < 4) return;
		drag.moved = true;
		drag.content.classList.add('tooltip-dragging');
		placeContent(drag.content, drag.left + dx, drag.top + dy, drag.rect);
	}
	function closeContents() {
		endDrag();
		contents.forEach(content => {content.style.display = 'none';});
		activeContent = null;
		if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
	}
	contents.forEach(content => {
		initialPositions.set(content, {left:content.style.left, top:content.style.top, transform:content.style.transform});
		// 全ての説明に専用のウィンドウバーを追加する。
		const handle = d.createElement('div');
		handle.className = 'tooltip-drag-bar tooltip-drag-handle';
		handle.setAttribute('title', 'ドラッグして移動');
		const grip = d.createElement('span');
		grip.className = 'tooltip-drag-grip';
		grip.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
		const hint = d.createElement('span');
		hint.className = 'tooltip-drag-hint';
		hint.textContent = 'ドラッグして移動';
		handle.appendChild(grip);

// 「主なスケジュール」「経済指標」の日付が本日なら today クラスを追加
// ただし「0:00〜7:00」は“前日”にも todayB を付ける
function scheduleDateNodes(root,selector) {
  const nodes=[];
  root=root||document;
  if(root.nodeType===1&&root.matches&&root.matches(selector))nodes.push(root);
  if(root.querySelectorAll)root.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach((node)=>nodes.push(node));
  return nodes;
}
function refreshScheduleDateClasses(force,root) {
  const now = new Date(Date.now()+9*36e5);
  const pad2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

  // --- 日付文字列の生成 ---
  // 当日
  const y = now.getUTCFullYear();
  const m = pad2(now.getUTCMonth() + 1);
  const d0 = pad2(now.getUTCDate());
  const todayYMD = `${y}-${m}-${d0}`;
  const todayMMDD = `${m}/${d0}`;
  const isEarlyMorning = (now.getUTCHours() < 7);
  const dateKey = todayYMD+'|'+(isEarlyMorning?'early':'day');
  if(!root&&!force&&nkScheduleDateKey===dateKey) return;
  if(!root)nkScheduleDateKey=dateKey;
  // 前日
  const prevDate = new Date(now);
  prevDate.setUTCDate(now.getUTCDate() - 1);
  const py = prevDate.getUTCFullYear();
  const pm = pad2(prevDate.getUTCMonth() + 1);
  const pd = pad2(prevDate.getUTCDate());
  const prevYMD = `${py}-${pm}-${pd}`;
  const prevMMDD = `${pm}/${pd}`;
  scheduleDateNodes(root,'.day.today,.day.todayB,.day.dSat,.day.dSun,.date.today,.date.todayB').forEach((el) => {
    el.classList.remove('today','todayB','dSat','dSun');
  });
  // --- クラス付与の共通関数 ---
  const applyClass = (dateValue, elementToMark) => {
    if (!dateValue || !elementToMark) return;
    // 当日判定
    if (dateValue === todayYMD || dateValue === todayMMDD) {
      elementToMark.classList.add('today');
    }
    // 前日判定 (早朝のみ)
    else if (isEarlyMorning && (dateValue === prevYMD || dateValue === prevMMDD)) {
      elementToMark.classList.add('todayB');
    }
  };

  // --- 各要素への適用 ---
  // 1) .day time[datetime] の YYYY-MM-DD 比較
  scheduleDateNodes(root,'.day time[datetime]').forEach((t) => {
    const ymd = (t.getAttribute('datetime') || '').slice(0, 10);
    applyClass(ymd, t.closest('.day'));
    // 土日の色分け (dSat/dSun)
    const dEl = t.closest('.day');
    if (dEl) {
      const dow = new Date(ymd + 'T00:00:00').getDay();
      if (dow === 6) dEl.classList.add('dSat');
      else if (dow === 0) dEl.classList.add('dSun');
    }
  });
  // 2) .date の先頭5文字(MM/DD)比較
  scheduleDateNodes(root,".date").forEach((el) => {
    const textMMDD = el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 5);
    applyClass(textMMDD, el);
  });
  // 3) .day の先頭5文字(MM/DD)比較
  scheduleDateNodes(root,".day").forEach((el) => {
    // すでに 1) で time要素経由で today/todayB が付いている場合はスキップ
    if (el.classList.contains('today') || el.classList.contains('todayB')) return;
    const textMMDD = el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 5);
    applyClass(textMMDD, el);
  });
}
let nkScheduleDateObserver=null;
function startScheduleDateObserver(){
  if(nkScheduleDateObserver||d.hidden||!d.body||typeof MutationObserver!=='function')return;
  nkScheduleDateObserver=new MutationObserver(function(mutations){
    const roots=[];
    mutations.forEach(function(mutation){
	  if(mutation.type==='attributes'){
		const root=mutation.target&&mutation.target.closest&&mutation.target.closest('.day');
		if(root&&roots.indexOf(root)<0)roots.push(root);
		return;
	  }
      if(mutation.type==='characterData'){
        const parent=mutation.target&&mutation.target.parentElement;
        const root=parent&&parent.closest&&parent.closest('.day,.date');
        if(root&&roots.indexOf(root)<0)roots.push(root);
        return;
      }
	  const targetRoot=mutation.target&&mutation.target.closest&&mutation.target.closest('.day,.date');
	  if(targetRoot&&roots.indexOf(targetRoot)<0)roots.push(targetRoot);
      mutation.addedNodes.forEach(function(node){
        const element=node.nodeType===1?node:node.parentElement;
        if(!element)return;
        const closest=element.closest&&element.closest('.day,.date');
        const root=closest||((element.querySelector&&element.querySelector('.day,.date,.day time[datetime]'))?element:null);
        if(root&&roots.indexOf(root)<0)roots.push(root);
      });
    });
    roots.forEach(function(root){refreshScheduleDateClasses(true,root);});
  });
  nkScheduleDateObserver.observe(d.body,{childList:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['datetime'],subtree:true});
}
function stopScheduleDateObserver(){
  if(nkScheduleDateObserver){try{nkScheduleDateObserver.disconnect();}catch(e){}nkScheduleDateObserver=null;}
}

// anchor_offset.js（閉じた後の余白が残らない版）
(function(d){
  var html = d.documentElement;
  var raf = 0;
  var anchorEl = null;
  var mo = null, ro = null, bodyMo = null, modeMo = null;
  var checkTimer = 0;

  // Observerで拾えない変化だけを低頻度で補完する
  var CHECK_MS = 5000;

  function isBottomMode(){
    return html.classList.contains('fmBottom');
  }

  function setAnchorH(px){
    // html.style.setProperty('--sb-anchor-h', (px|0) + 'px');
    var value=(px|0)+'px';if(html.style.getPropertyValue('--sb-anchor-bottom-h')!==value)html.style.setProperty('--sb-anchor-bottom-h',value);
  }

  function requestUpdate(){
    if(d.hidden || raf) return;
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(update);
  }

  // 「画面下端にかぶっている高さ」だけ返す（上アンカーは 0）
  function visibleOverlapHeight(el){
    if(!el) return 0;

    var cs = window.getComputedStyle(el);
    if(cs.display === 'none' || cs.visibility === 'hidden' || cs.opacity === '0') return 0;

    var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    var vh = window.innerHeight || d.documentElement.clientHeight || 0;

    // ★下端に届いてない＝下アンカーじゃない → 0
    if(r.bottom < vh - 6) return 0;
    if(r.top >= vh) return 0;

    // 画面下端(vh)に対して、要素がどれだけ食い込んでいるか
    var inter = vh - Math.max(r.top, 0);
    inter = Math.min(inter, r.height);
    if(inter < 6) return 0;

    // data-anchor-status があれば、閉じ系っぽい文字で 0 扱い
    var s = (el.getAttribute('data-anchor-status') || '').toLowerCase();
    if(s && /(closed|close|dismiss|collapse|collapsed|hidden|off|none)/.test(s)) return 0;

    // 中身が消えて「空の箱」だけ残るケース対策
    var ifr = el.querySelector('iframe');
    if(ifr){
      var ir = ifr.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(ir.height < 6 || ir.width < 20){
        var kids = el.children, ok = false;
        for(var i=0;i<kids.length;i++){
          var kr = kids[i].getBoundingClientRect();
          if(kr.height > 6 && kr.width > 20){ ok = true; break; }
        }
        if(!ok) return 0;
      }
    }else{
      var kids2 = el.children, ok2 = false;
      for(var j=0;j<kids2.length;j++){
        var kr2 = kids2[j].getBoundingClientRect();
        if(kr2.height > 6 && kr2.width > 20){ ok2 = true; break; }
      }
      if(!ok2 && (el.textContent || '').trim() === '') return 0;
    }

    return Math.round(inter);
  }

  function findAnchor(){
    // 既存の検出と同じ：data-anchor-status を持つ要素群
    var els = d.querySelectorAll('[data-anchor-status]');
    if(!els || !els.length) return null;

    // いちばん「見えてる高さ」が大きいものを採用
    var best = null, bestH = 0;
    for(var i=0;i<els.length;i++){
      var h = visibleOverlapHeight(els[i]);
      if(h > bestH){ bestH = h; best = els[i]; }
    }
    return best;
  }

  function attachWatch(el){
    if(el === anchorEl) return;

    anchorEl = el;

    if(mo) try{ mo.disconnect(); }catch(e){}
    if(ro) try{ ro.disconnect(); }catch(e){}
    mo = null;
    ro = null;

    if(!el) return;

    // 変化が取れるときは取る（取れないケースは定期チェックが拾う）
    try{
      mo = new MutationObserver(requestUpdate);
      mo.observe(el, {
        attributes:true,
        subtree:true,
        attributeFilter:['data-anchor-status','style','class']
      });
    }catch(e){}

    if('ResizeObserver' in window){
      try{
        ro = new ResizeObserver(requestUpdate);
        ro.observe(el);
      }catch(e){}
    }
  }

  function update(){
    raf = 0;

    if(!isBottomMode()){
      attachWatch(null);
      setAnchorH(0);
      return;
    }

    var el = findAnchor();
    attachWatch(el);

    var h = visibleOverlapHeight(el);

    // 見つからない場合は 0 に戻す（余白残り対策）
    setAnchorH(h);
  }

  function syncMode(){
    if(!isBottomMode()){
      if(checkTimer){clearTimeout(checkTimer);checkTimer=0;}
      attachWatch(null);
      if(bodyMo){try{bodyMo.disconnect();}catch(e){}bodyMo=null;}
      setAnchorH(0);
      return;
    }
    startPageObservers();
    requestUpdate();
    scheduleCheck();
  }

  // 表示中だけページ全体と配置モードを監視する
  function startPageObservers(){
    if(d.hidden||typeof MutationObserver!=='function')return;
    if(isBottomMode()&&!bodyMo){
      try{bodyMo=new MutationObserver(function(mutations){
        for(var i=0;i<mutations.length;i++){
          var mutation=mutations[i],target=mutation.target;
          if(target.closest&&target.closest('[data-anchor-status]')){requestUpdate();return;}
          var nodes=Array.prototype.slice.call(mutation.addedNodes).concat(Array.prototype.slice.call(mutation.removedNodes));
          for(var j=0;j<nodes.length;j++){var node=nodes[j];if(node.nodeType===1&&(node.matches('[data-anchor-status],ins.adsbygoogle,iframe')||node.querySelector('[data-anchor-status],ins.adsbygoogle,iframe'))){requestUpdate();return;}}
        }
      });bodyMo.observe(d.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});}catch(e){bodyMo=null;}
    }
    if(!modeMo){
      try{modeMo=new MutationObserver(syncMode);modeMo.observe(html,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});}catch(e){modeMo=null;}
    }
  }
  function stopPageObservers(){
    if(bodyMo){try{bodyMo.disconnect();}catch(e){}bodyMo=null;}
    if(modeMo){try{modeMo.disconnect();}catch(e){}modeMo=null;}
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', requestUpdate);
  window.addEventListener('scroll', requestUpdate, {passive:true});

  // 保険：閉じ操作がDOM変化を起こさないケースを拾う。非表示中は停止する。
  function scheduleCheck(){
    if(checkTimer){clearTimeout(checkTimer);checkTimer=0;}
    if(d.hidden||!isBottomMode()) return;
    checkTimer=setTimeout(function(){
      checkTimer=0;
      if(!isBottomMode()){attachWatch(null);setAnchorH(0);return;}
      requestUpdate();
      scheduleCheck();
    },CHECK_MS);
  }
  d.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){
    if(d.hidden){
      if(checkTimer){clearTimeout(checkTimer);checkTimer=0;}
      if(raf){if(window.cancelAnimationFrame)window.cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;}
      attachWatch(null);
      stopPageObservers();
    }else{
      startPageObservers();
      syncMode();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('pagehide',function(){
    if(checkTimer){clearTimeout(checkTimer);checkTimer=0;}
    if(raf){if(window.cancelAnimationFrame)window.cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;}
    attachWatch(null);
    stopPageObservers();
  });
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',function(){if(!d.hidden){startPageObservers();syncMode();}});

  startPageObservers();
  syncMode();
})(document);

// Yahoo URLからコード・種別・ページを抽出（正規化）
function parseYahooUrl(url){
	if(!url || typeof url !== 'string') return null;
	// 国内 Yahoo (新チャート): //finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/XXXX.T/chart
	var m1c = url.match(/\/\/finance\.yahoo\.co\.jp\/quote\/([^\/\.]+)\.T\/chart(?:$|[?#\/])/);
	if(m1c) return {code:m1c[1], type:'jp', page:'chart'};
	// 国内 Yahoo (新形式): //finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/XXXX.T
	var m1 =url.match(/\/\/finance\.yahoo\.co\.jp\/quote\/([^\/\.]+)\.T(?:$|[?#\/])/);
	if(m1 && !/\.T\/(news|profile|history|incentive)/.test(url)) return {code:m1[1], type:'jp', page:'quote'};
	// 国内 Yahoo (旧形式): //stocks.finance.yahoo.co.jp/stocks/detail/?code=XXXX.T
	var m2 = url.match(/\/\/stocks\.finance\.yahoo\.co\.jp\/stocks\/detail\/\?code=([^&\.]+)\.T/);
	if(m2) return {code:m2[1], type:'jp', page:'quote'};
	// 国内 Yahoo (旧チャート): //stocks.finance.yahoo.co.jp/stocks/chart/?code=XXXX.T
	var m2c = url.match(/\/\/stocks\.finance\.yahoo\.co\.jp\/stocks\/chart\/\?code=([^&\.]+)\.T/);
	if(m2c) return {code:m2c[1], type:'jp', page:'chart'};
	// 海外 Yahoo チャート: //finance.yahoo.com/quote/{SYMBOL}/chart/
	var m3c = url.match(/\/\/finance\.yahoo\.com\/quote\/([^\/\?#]+)\/chart/);
	if(m3c) return {code:m3c[1], type:'us', page:'chart'};
	// 海外 Yahoo 概要: //finance.yahoo.com/quote/{SYMBOL}
	var m3 = url.match(/\/\/finance\.yahoo\.com\/quote\/([^\/\?#]+)/);
	if(m3) return {code:m3[1], type:'us', page:'quote'};
	return null;
}

function resolveAnchorFormat(){

    try{

      }
    }catch(_){}
  }

  function isMobileLike(){
    try{
      if(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) return true;
      if(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1024px)').matches) return true;
    }catch(_){}
    return false;
  }

  function getFloatPos(){
    try{
      var html = document.documentElement;

      // 1) すでに applyFloat 済みなら class を最優先
      if(html.classList.contains('fmTop')) return {v:'T', src:'class:fmTop'};
      if(html.classList.contains('fmBottom')) return {v:'B', src:'class:fmBottom'};
      if(html.classList.contains('fmNone')) return {v:'N', src:'class:fmNone'};

      // 2) localStorage の保存値
      var s = '';
      try{ s = localStorage.getItem('SITE_FLOAT_POS') || ''; }catch(_){}
      if(s === 'T' || s === 'B' || s === 'N'){
        return {v:s, src:'localStorage:SITE_FLOAT_POS'};
      }

      // 3) 未保存時は foot.php 側と同じ端末デフォルト
      // PC=T、スマホ/タブレット=B
      var m = isMobileLike();
      return {
        v: m ? 'B' : 'T',
        src: m ? 'autoDefault:mobile=B' : 'autoDefault:pc=T'
      };
    }catch(_){}

    return {v:'', src:'none'};
  }

  try{
    var fp = getFloatPos();

    // 上部固定メニューなら、アンカー広告は下
    if(fp.v === 'T'){
      window.ANCHOR_POS = 'bottom';
      logAnchor(fp.src, fp.v, 'BOTTOM_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.BOTTOM_ANCHOR;
    }

    // 下部固定メニューなら、アンカー広告は上
    if(fp.v === 'B'){
      window.ANCHOR_POS = 'top';
      logAnchor(fp.src, fp.v, 'TOP_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.TOP_ANCHOR;
    }

    // 固定なしの場合だけ既存の通常判定へ
    if(fp.v === 'N'){
      logAnchor(fp.src, fp.v, 'fallback');
    }
  }catch(_){}

  // ★ readTopH() で window.ANCHOR_POS='top' にする処理は削除する
  // 上メニューあり → TOP_ANCHOR になってしまうため

  try{
    if(window.ANCHOR_POS === 'top'){
      logAnchor('window.ANCHOR_POS', '', 'TOP_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.TOP_ANCHOR;
    }

    if(window.ANCHOR_POS === 'bottom'){
      logAnchor('window.ANCHOR_POS', '', 'BOTTOM_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.BOTTOM_ANCHOR;
    }

    var ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    var isPad = (ua.indexOf('Android') > 0 && ua.indexOf('Mobile') === -1) || /iPad|Macintosh/.test(ua);
    var isPh  = (ua.indexOf('Android') > 0 && ua.indexOf('Mobile') > 0) || ua.indexOf('iPhone') > 0;

    if(isPh || isPad){
      logAnchor('ua', '', 'TOP_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.TOP_ANCHOR;
    }

    logAnchor('ua', '', 'BOTTOM_ANCHOR');
    return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.BOTTOM_ANCHOR;

  }catch(_){
    logAnchor('catch', '', 'BOTTOM_ANCHOR');
    return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.BOTTOM_ANCHOR;
  }
}

/* ▼ボタンを必ず均等割り（2個でも3個でも余りなし） */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap{
  width:240px;                 /* 全体幅：25%狭めた値（必要なら微調整） */
  display:grid !important;
  grid-auto-flow:column;
  grid-auto-columns:1fr;
  margin:0 !important;
}
/* ボタンはセルいっぱいに伸ばす */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button{
  width:100% !important;
  min-width:0 !important;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding:8px 0;               /* 横paddingを0にして“等分感”を揃える（好みで 8px 6px でもOK） */
  text-align:center;
}
/* 区切り線（固定なし｜上部固定｜下部固定 すべてに線が入る） */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button + button{
  border-left:1px solid #555;
}
/* activeで border-color を青に変える既存指定がある場合の保険 */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button.is-active{
  border-left-color:#555;
}
/* ラベルをボタンの左に“同じ高さ”で並べる（強制） */
.toggleGrid{
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 140px 240px; /* 左:ラベル幅 / 右:ボタン群幅（25%狭めた幅） */
  column-gap:8px;
  row-gap:10px;
  align-items:center;
  justify-items:start;
}
.toggleGridLabel{
  text-align:left !important;
  justify-self:start;
  margin:0 !important;
  padding:0 !important;
  line-height:1.1;
}
/* 右側（ボタン群）を行頭に固定 */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap{
  margin:0 !important;
  justify-self:start;
}

/* ===== FloatMenu (#topmenu) 3パターン：下部固定が必ず効く版（重複なし） ===== */
:root{
  --sb-body-left: 0px;
  --sb-body-width: 100vw;
  --sb-topmenu-h: 62px;
  --sb-anchor-h: 0px;
  --sb-anchor-bottom-h: 0px;  /* 下側アンカー専用 */
}

/* 固定なし：.fixed が付いても殺す（強制上書き） */
html.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu,
html.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu.fixed,
body.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu,
body.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu.fixed{
  position: static !important;
  top: auto !important;
  bottom: auto !important;
  left: auto !important;
  right: auto !important;
  width: auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  z-index:auto !important;
}
/* 上部固定：通常時は自然配置へ戻す（既存CSSがfixedでも事故らない） */
html.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu,
body.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu{
  position: static !important;
  top:auto !important;
  bottom:auto !important;
  left:auto !important;
  right:auto !important;
  width:auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  z-index:auto !important;
}
/* 上部固定：.fixed の時だけ固定（スクロール閾値ロジック維持） */
html.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu.fixed,
body.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu.fixed{
  position: fixed !important;
  top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) !important;
  bottom: auto !important;
  left: var(--sb-body-left) !important;
  width: var(--sb-body-width) !important;
  right: auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  box-sizing:border-box !important;
  z-index:999999 !important;
}
/* 下部固定：常時固定（ここが本命：top を必ず殺す） */
html.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu,
html.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu.fixed,
body.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu,
body.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu.fixed{
  position: fixed !important;
  top: auto !important; /* ← これが残ると下に行かない */
  /* bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + var(--sb-anchor-h)) !important; */
  bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + var(--sb-anchor-bottom-h)) !important;
  left: var(--sb-body-left) !important;
  width: var(--sb-body-width) !important;
  right: auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  box-sizing:border-box !important;
  z-index:999999 !important;
}
/* 下部固定時：本文が隠れないように下余白（anchor-h=0でもOK） */
html.fmBottom body,
body.fmBottom{
  /* padding-bottom: calc(var(--sb-topmenu-h) + var(--sb-anchor-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important; */
  padding-bottom: calc(var(--sb-topmenu-h) + var(--sb-anchor-bottom-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
}

/* 初期化はDOM構築後、レイアウト計測は1フレームに1回だけ行う。 */
function nkOnReady(fn){
    if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',fn,{once:true});
    else fn();
}
/* defer実行中とDOMContentLoaded後を区別し、既存ランキングの初期化を優先する。 */
window.nkDomContentLoaded=document.readyState!=='loading';
if(!window.nkDomContentLoaded)document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){window.nkDomContentLoaded=true;},{once:true});
function nkFrameOnce(fn){

/* ajaxindex の差分ファイル(*_diff.js)を使う読み込み。2026-11-12 *_d.js から *_diff.js に変更。
   差分ファイルには直近10秒に変わった行だけが入る(行は全体と同じ A[コード]="...")。
   初回・60秒ごと・前回の成功から8秒以上空いた・前回失敗のときは全体ファイルを読む。
   差分を出しているファイルだけ DIFF に書く。それ以外は従来どおり全体ファイル。
   2026-11-16 2段目: DIFF5 のファイルは前回の成功から3秒未満なら *_diff5.js(直近5秒に変わった行)を読む。
   *_diff5.js が読めなかったときは10分間 *_diff.js に戻す(makefile 未反映でも動くように)。 */
(function(w){
    var DIFF={ajax_dow:1,ajax_cme2:1,ajax_nikkei:1,ajax_TOP2:1,ajax_TOP_225:1,ajax_TOP_ch225:1,ajax_TOP_mid:1,ajax_TOP_btm:1,ajax_bitcoin:1,ajax_asia:1,ajax_oil:1,ajax_euro:1},DIFF5={ajax_dow:1,ajax_cme2:1,ajax_TOP2:1,ajax_bitcoin:1},state=Object.create(null);

    else text.attr({text:caption,y:textY,zIndex:2001-z}).css({color:color});

/* 従来型の複合チャート用。ページ固有の系列・Cookie・期間は各JSに残す。 */
function nkCreateCompositeController(key,getChart,interval){
    var mode=-1,generation=0,requests=[],poll=null,ready=false;
    function cancel(){
        generation++;
        if(poll){poll.stop();poll=null;}
        var old=requests;requests=[];old.forEach(function(request){request.abort();});
    }
    window.addEventListener('marketupdatesstop',cancel);
    return {
        begin:function(nextMode){cancel();mode=Number(nextMode);ready=false;},
        ajax:function(options){
            var token=generation;
            if(typeof options.timeout==='undefined')options.timeout=12000;
            var request=$.ajax(options),rawDone=request.done,rawFail=request.fail;
            requests.push(request);
            request.always(function(){var i=requests.indexOf(request);if(i>=0)requests.splice(i,1);});
            function guard(fn){return function(){if(token===generation)return fn.apply(this,arguments);};}
            request.done=function(fn){if(typeof fn==='function')rawDone.call(request,guard(fn));return request;};
            request.fail=function(fn){if(typeof fn==='function')rawFail.call(request,guard(fn));return request;};
            return request;
        },
        start:function(load,initialize){
            if(poll)poll.stop();
            // 自動更新停止後も、利用者が選んだ期間の初回表示は実行する。
            if(window.nkMarketUpdatesAllowed&&!nkMarketUpdatesAllowed()){
                initialize();return {stop:cancel};
            }
            poll=nkStartMarketPoll(key,function(){
                if(mode!==2||requests.length)return $.Deferred().resolve().promise();
                if(!ready||!getChart()){
                    var token=generation,request=initialize();
                    request.done(function(){if(token===generation&&getChart())ready=true;});
                    return request;
                }
                return load();
            },interval);
            return poll;
        },
        version:function(){return generation;},
        mode:function(){return mode;}
    };
}
/* タブが5分以上隠れていたらWebSocketを切り、表示に戻ったらつなぎ直す。
   タブを大量に開くと接続がブラウザの上限まで貯まり、新しいページの通信が待たされるため。
   socket.ioが window.io を設定した時点で包み、作られたソケットを覚えておく。
   head5 と ssi_11_head の両方に同じ処理があり、先に読まれた方だけ動く。 */
(function(w,d){
    if(w.nkSocketIdleInstalled)return;
    w.nkSocketIdleInstalled=true;
    var IDLE_MS=5*60*1000,sockets=[],timer=0,current=w.io;
    function wrap(io){
        if(typeof io!=='function'||io._nkIdleWrapped)return io;
        var wrapped=function(){
            var socket=io.apply(this,arguments);
            if(socket&&typeof socket.disconnect==='function'&&typeof socket.connect==='function'){
                // ページ側で切って作り直した古いソケットは覚えておかない。
                sockets=sockets.filter(function(s){return s.active||s._nkIdle;});
                sockets.push(socket);
            }
            return socket;
        };
        for(var key in io)if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(io,key))wrapped[key]=io[key];
        wrapped._nkIdleWrapped=true;
        return wrapped;
    }
    try{
        current=wrap(current);
        Object.defineProperty(w,'io',{configurable:true,enumerable:true,get:function(){return current;},set:function(value){current=wrap(value);}});
    }catch(e){return;}
    function sleep(){
        timer=0;
        if(!d.hidden)return;
        // ページ側で切ったソケット(active=false)は触らない。
        sockets=sockets.filter(function(socket){return socket.active||socket._nkIdle;});
        sockets.forEach(function(socket){
            if(!socket.active)return;
            socket._nkIdle=true;
            try{socket.disconnect();}catch(e){}
        });
    }
    function wake(){
        if(timer){clearTimeout(timer);timer=0;}
        var woke=false;
        sockets.forEach(function(socket){
            if(!socket._nkIdle)return;
            socket._nkIdle=false;woke=true;
            try{socket.connect();}catch(e){}
        });
        // 切断中の値はSocketで補えないため、チャートを作り直すページへ知らせる。
        if(woke)try{w.dispatchEvent(new Event('nksocketwake'));}catch(e){}
    }
    d.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){
        if(d.hidden){if(!timer)timer=setTimeout(sleep,IDLE_MS);}
        else wake();
    });
    w.addEventListener('pageshow',function(){if(!d.hidden)wake();});

<script>
(function (global) {
  function buildEvents() {
    // EVE が正しく配列で入っているかチェック
    if (!global.EVE || !global.EVE.length) return;

    var eveDiv = document.getElementById("eveDIV");
    if (!eveDiv) return;

    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

    for (var i = 0; i < global.EVE.length; i++) {
      var line = global.EVE[i];
      if (!line) continue;

      var p = line.split("_");
      if (p.length < 5) continue;

      var time = p[0];             // 14:00 or 12/10 など
      var cat1 = p[1];             // 株式市場
      var cat2 = p[2];             // 後場OPEN
      var area = p[3];             // タグが入っていてもOK
      var slug = (p[4] || "").trim();  // china or ""

      // デイリーデータ判定（時間に / が入っているか）
      var isDaily = (time.indexOf("/") !== -1);

      var eve = document.createElement("div");
      eve.className = isDaily ? "eve day" : "eve";

      var tt = document.createElement("tt");
      tt.textContent = time;
      eve.appendChild(tt);
      eve.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" "));

      var span = document.createElement("span");
      span.className = "eve2";

      // 「市場休日」が入っていたら eve2 holiday にする
      var hay = [cat1, cat2, area].join(" ");
      if (hay.indexOf("市場休日") !== -1) {
        span.className += " holiday";
      }

      var html = "";

      if (slug) {
        var url = "//nikkei225jp.com/" + encodeURIComponent(slug) + "/";
        html += '<a href="' + url + '" target="_self">' + area + '</a>';
      } else {
        html += area;
      }
      html += " " + cat1 + " " + cat2;

      span.innerHTML = html; // タグをエスケープしない
      eve.appendChild(span);
      frag.appendChild(eve);
    }

    eveDiv.appendChild(frag);
  }

  // DOM と EVE が揃うまで少しだけ待つ
  var retry = 0;
  var maxRetry = 50;

  function tryBuild() {
    if (global.EVE && global.EVE.length && document.getElementById("eveDIV")) {
      buildEvents();
    } else if (retry < maxRetry) {
      retry++;
      setTimeout(tryBuild, 100);
    } else {
      // ここまで来たら EVE が定義されていないか eveDIV が無い想定
      if (global.console && console.warn) {
        console.warn("EVE events not built (EVE or eveDIV missing)");
      }
    }
  }

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(tryBuild);
})(window);

<script>
var nowNewsTab=1;
var thisRssNo="TOP2";
function side_news(N,n) {
	if(n>0){nowNewsTab=n;}
	if(nowNewsTab==1){N='TOP2'}else{N=thisRssNo}
	fetch("/_data/_nfsDATA/rss/News_"+N+".js")
		.then(response => response.text())
		.then(js => {
			eval(js);	// News_TOP2.js が window に News 配列を定義するような形式と仮定して eval
			var dT = "", nT = "" ,kensu =20;
			if(N=="TOP2" || N==6 || N==8 || N==9 || N==15)kensu =30;
			for (let i = 0; i < News.length && i < kensu; i++) {
				var ns = News[i].split("__");
				var ch = ((ns[5] != 'ch225') && (ns[5] != 'DAY') && (ns[5] != 'alert'));
				var tm = (ns[5] == 'DAY')
					? (ns[1] + "").replace(/\d\d\d\d\//, "").replace(/\d\d:\d\d/, "")
					: (N!='TOP2') ?(ns[1] + "").replace(/\d\d\d\d\//, ""):(ns[1] + "").replace(/\d\d\d\d\/\d\d\/\d\d /, "");
				var isBloomberg =
					/Bloomberg|ブルームバーグ/i.test(ns[5]) ||
					/bloomberg\.(com|co\.jp)/i.test(ns[6]);
				var paidBadge = isBloomberg
					? '<span class="paid-badge" title="リンク先は要購読記事です">'
					+ '<svg class="paid-lock-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">'
					+ '<rect width="18" height="11" x="3" y="11" rx="2"></rect>'
					+ '<path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"></path>'
					+ '</svg>要購読</span>'
					: '';
				if (ns[5] == 'DAY') {
					if (ns[7].match(/225決算|NY決算|市場休日/)) {
						ns[7] = '<a href=/schedule/ target=_self>' + ns[7] + '</a>';
					}
					dT += '<li class=evet><tt>' + tm + '</tt><span>' + ns[7] + '</span></li>';
				} else if (ns[5] == 'ch225') {
					// skip
				} else if (ns[5] == 'alert') {
					tm = tm.replace(/\d\d\/\d\d /, "");
					if (ns[7].match(/ダウ/)) {
						nT += '<a href=/nasdaq/ target=_self class=newsAlert><li class="alert ' + ns[7].match(/alupt|aldwt/) + '"><tt>' + tm + '</tt><span>' + ns[7] + '</span></li></a>';
					}else if(ns[7].match(/CFD/)) {
						nT += '<a href=/cme/ target=_self class=newsAlert><li class="alert ' + ns[7].match(/alupt|aldwt/) + '"><tt>' + tm + '</tt><span>' + ns[7] + '</span></li></a>';
					}else if(ns[7].match(/日本225/)) {
						nT += '<a href=/chart/ target=_self class=newsAlert><li class="alert ' + ns[7].match(/alupt|aldwt/) + '"><tt>' + tm + '</tt><span>' + ns[7] + '</span></li></a>';
					}else if(ns[7].match(/ドル円/)) {
						nT += '<a href=/fx/ target=_self class=newsAlert><li class="alert ' + ns[7].match(/alupt|aldwt/) + '"><tt>' + tm + '</tt><span>' + ns[7] + '</span></li></a>';
					}
				} else {
					var a1 = (ch) ? '<a href="//jump.nikkei225jp.com/j.php?URL=' + encodeURIComponent(ns[6]) + '" target="_blank" rel="nofollow" title="' + ns[7] + ' [' + ns[5] + ']">' : '';
					var a2 = (ch) ? '</a>' : '';
					var w = ns[8] / 10;
					if (w > 100) w = 100;
					var c = (w == 0) ? '#000' : (w < 20) ? '#adf' : (w < 40) ? '#8ea' : (w < 60) ? '#fc0' : (w < 80) ? '#f80' : '#f22';
					nT += '<li class=news><tt>' + tm + '<span class=progress><span style="width:' + w + '%;background:' + c + ';" class=progress_div></span></span></tt><span>' + a1 + ns[7] + paidBadge + '<i> ' + ns[5] + '</i>' + a2 + '</span></li>';
				}
			}
			d.getElementById("newsDIV").innerHTML = '<ul class=news2>' + nT + '</ul>';
		});
}

<script>
(function (global) {

  // -----------------------------
  // パース系
  // -----------------------------
  function parseLine(line) {
    if (typeof line !== "string" || !line) return null;
    var parts = line.split("_");
    if (parts.length < 7) return null;

    var id       = parts[0];
    var perStr   = parts[1] || "0";
    var colClass = parts[2] || "";
    var path     = parts[3] || "/";
    var nameParts = parts.slice(4, parts.length - 2);
    var name      = nameParts.join("_");
    var time      = parts[parts.length - 2] || "";
    var ttRaw     = parseInt(parts[parts.length - 1], 10);
    var ttype     = isNaN(ttRaw) ? 0 : ttRaw;
    var per       = parseFloat(perStr) || 0;

    return {
      id: id,
      per: per,
      perStr: perStr,
      colClass: colClass,
      path: path,
      name: name,
      time: time,
      ttype: ttype
    };
  }

  function parseLines(list) {
    var out = [];
    if (!list || typeof list.length === "undefined") return out;
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      var obj = parseLine(list[i]);
      if (obj) out.push(obj);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // 背景色計算
  // -----------------------------
  function getBgColor(val, e) {
    // Color.js の保存済み配色を優先。未読込のページは従来色を使用する。
    if (typeof global.colGetPer2BG === "function") {
      return global.colGetPer2BG(val, e);
    }

    var RITU  = 98;
    var BASE  = 90;
    var BASE2 = 100;
    var MAX   = 225;

    var a = Number(val);
    if (!isFinite(a)) a = 0;

    var scale = 1;
    if (e !== undefined && e !== null && e !== 0) {
      scale = 1 / e;
    }

    if (Math.abs(a) / scale < 0.0001) {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    }

    var n = Math.round(RITU * Math.abs(a) * scale + BASE2);
    if (n > MAX) n = MAX;

    if (a > 0) {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + n + "," + BASE + ")";
    } else if (a < 0) {
      return "rgb(" + n + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    } else {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // DOM に描画
  // -----------------------------
  function build(list, isUp, box) {
    if (!box) return;

    var items = parseLines(list);
    if (!items.length) return;

    // 既存の a.UpdwArap を削除
    var olds = box.querySelectorAll("a.UpdwArap");
    for (var i = 0; i < olds.length; i++) {
      var el = olds[i];
      if (el && el.parentNode) {
        el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
      }
    }

    var arrowText = isUp ? "▲" : "▼";

    for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) {
      var it = items[j];

      var href = "//nikkei225jp.com" + (it.path || "/");

      // <a>
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.className = "UpdwArap";
      a.href = href;
      a.target = "_self";

      // パーセント表示部分
      var c = document.createElement("div");
      c.className = "UpDwC";
      // 配色変更時に背景だけ更新できるよう、符号付きの変化率を保持する。
      c.setAttribute("data-side-rank-per", String(it.per));
      c.style.background = getBgColor(it.per, 3);

      var arrow = document.createElement("span");
      arrow.className = "alw";
      arrow.appendChild(document.createTextNode(arrowText));

      var pct = document.createElement("span");
      pct.className = "sm50";
      pct.appendChild(document.createTextNode("%"));

      c.appendChild(arrow);
      c.appendChild(document.createTextNode(Math.abs(it.per || 0).toFixed(2)));
      c.appendChild(pct);
      a.appendChild(c);

      // 名前部分
      var udnm = document.createElement("span");
      udnm.className = "UDnm";

      var col = document.createElement("span");
      col.className = it.colClass || "";

      var nameSpan = document.createElement("span");
      nameSpan.innerHTML = it.name || ""; // 元が .html(it.name) なので innerHTML

      udnm.appendChild(col);
      udnm.appendChild(nameSpan);
      a.appendChild(udnm);

      // 時刻部分
      var timeClass = (it.ttype === 1) ? "timUD1" : "timUD0";
      var timeSpan = document.createElement("span");
      timeSpan.className = timeClass;
      timeSpan.appendChild(document.createTextNode(it.time));
      a.appendChild(timeSpan);

      box.appendChild(a);
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // DOM Ready
  // -----------------------------
  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(function () {
    var upBox = document.getElementById("UpdwU");
    var dwBox = document.getElementById("UpdwD");
    if (!upBox && !dwBox) return;

    // HTML で読み込まれたグローバル変数を利用
    var upList = global.PERup;
    var dwList = global.PERdw;

    if (upList && upBox) {
      build(upList, true, upBox);
    }
    if (dwList && dwBox) {
      build(dwList, false, dwBox);
    }
  });

  // データの再取得や一覧の作り直しをせず、配色変更を即時反映する。
  global.addEventListener("trendcolorchange", function () {
    var badges = document.querySelectorAll("#sideRANK .UpDwC[data-side-rank-per]");
    for (var i = 0; i < badges.length; i++) {
      var value = Number(badges[i].getAttribute("data-side-rank-per"));
      badges[i].style.background = getBgColor(value, 3);
    }
  });

})(window);
</script>

function deleteAllCookies(silent) {
	const currentPath=location.pathname.replace(/[^/]*$/, "");
	const paths=Array.from(new Set(["/",currentPath,currentPath.replace(/\/$/, ""),"/"+(typeof pageName!=="undefined"?pageName:"")]));
	const cookies = document.cookie.split(";");
	for (const cookie of cookies) {
		const eqPos = cookie.indexOf("=");
		const name = eqPos > -1 ? cookie.substr(0, eqPos).trim() : cookie.trim();
		for (const path of paths) {
		document.cookie = `${name}=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT;path=${path}`;
		}
	}
	if(silent!==true)alert("このページのクッキーを削除しました。");
}


// WorldTime
const nkWorldTimeFormatters = {
	"Asia/Tokyo": new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23"}),
	"America/New_York": new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone:"America/New_York",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23"})
};
const nkWorldDateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ja-JP", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",year:"numeric",month:"2-digit",day:"2-digit"});
const nkWorldWeekdayFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ja-JP", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",weekday:"long"});
const nkWorldWeekdayEnFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",weekday:"short"});
function updateTime(targetId, timeZone) {
	const now = new Date();
	// "JST" を指定した場合も、PCのローカル時刻ではなく東京時刻を使う
	const resolvedTimeZone = (timeZone === "JST") ? "Asia/Tokyo" : timeZone;
	const formatter = nkWorldTimeFormatters[resolvedTimeZone];
	if(!formatter) return;
	const timeParts = formatter.formatToParts(now);
	const hour = Number(timeParts.find((part) => part.type === "hour").value);
	const minute = timeParts.find((part) => part.type === "minute").value;
	const formattedTime = `${String(hour).padStart(2, "0")}:${minute}`;

	if (resolvedTimeZone === "Asia/Tokyo") {
		const formattedDate = nkWorldDateFormatter.format(now);
		const formattedDay = nkWorldWeekdayFormatter.format(now);

		const dateElem = d.getElementById("WtimeT");
		if (dateElem) dateElem.textContent = formattedDate;
		const wElem = d.getElementById("WtimeW");
		if (wElem) {
			wElem.textContent = formattedDay;
			const day = nkWorldWeekdayEnFormatter.format(now);
			if (day === "Sun") {
				wElem.style.color = "#f77";   // 日曜
			} else if (day === "Sat") {
				wElem.style.color = "#69f";  // 土曜
			} else {
				wElem.style.color = "";
			}
		}
	}
	const timeColor = getTimeColor(hour);
	const targetEl = d.getElementById(targetId);
	if (targetEl) {
		targetEl.textContent = formattedTime;
		targetEl.style.color = timeColor;
	}
}

function getTimeColor(hour) {
	if (hour >= 7 && hour < 9) {
		return "#6c0";
	} else if (hour >= 9 && hour < 17) {
		return "#da5";
	} else if (hour >= 17 && hour < 20) {
		return "#47a";
	} else {
		return "#999";
	}
}

// modern-tooltip replacement for dhtmltooltip
let mTooltip, isTooltipVisible = false, lastMouseX = 0, lastMouseY = 0;

nkOnReady(() => {

});

function showTooltip(htmlContent) {
	if (!mTooltip) return;
	mTooltip.innerHTML = htmlContent;
	mTooltip.classList.add("visible");
	isTooltipVisible = true;
	nkPositionTooltip();
}
function hideTooltip() {
	if (!mTooltip) return;
	mTooltip.classList.remove("visible");
	isTooltipVisible = false;
}
function positionTooltipCoords(clientX, clientY) {
	if (!isTooltipVisible || !mTooltip) return;
	const padding = 10;
	const scrollX = window.scrollX || window.pageXOffset;
	const scrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
	const rect = mTooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
	const winW = window.innerWidth;
	const winH = window.innerHeight;
	let left = clientX + padding;
	let top = clientY + padding;
	if (left + rect.width > winW) {
		left = clientX - rect.width - padding;
		if (left < 0) left = padding;
	}
	if (top + rect.height > winH) {
		top = clientY - rect.height - padding;
		if (top < 0) top = padding;
	}
	mTooltip.style.left = `${left + scrollX}px`;
	mTooltip.style.top = `${top + scrollY}px`;
}

/* tooltip  replacement for micromodal */
nkOnReady(() => {
	const contents = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip-content'));
	const overlay = d.getElementById('overlay');
	const initialPositions = new WeakMap();
	let activeContent = null, drag = null;
	function placeContent(content, left, top, rect) {
		const margin = 8;
		// 固定幅ページを縮小表示するスマホでは clientWidth と表示範囲が異なる。
		const viewport = window.visualViewport;
		const width = viewport ? viewport.width : window.innerWidth;
		const height = viewport ? viewport.height : window.innerHeight;
		const minLeft = (viewport ? viewport.offsetLeft : 0) + margin;
		const minTop = (viewport ? viewport.offsetTop : 0) + margin;
		left = Math.max(minLeft, Math.min(left, Math.max(minLeft, minLeft + width - rect.width - margin * 2)));
		top = Math.max(minTop, Math.min(top, Math.max(minTop, minTop + height - rect.height - margin * 2)));
		// CSS zoom が指定されたページでも、画面上の座標を二重に縮小しない。
		const cssWidth = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(content).width);
		const scale = content.currentCSSZoom || (cssWidth > 0 ? rect.width / cssWidth : 1) || 1;
		content.style.transform = 'none';
		content.style.left = left / scale + 'px';
		content.style.top = top / scale + 'px';
		return {left, top};
	}
	function endDrag(evt) {
		if (!drag || (evt && evt.pointerId !== undefined && evt.pointerId !== drag.pointerId)) return;
		const finished = drag;
		drag = null;
		finished.content.classList.remove('tooltip-dragging');
		d.removeEventListener('pointermove', moveDrag);
		d.removeEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
		d.removeEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
		if (finished.handle.hasPointerCapture(finished.pointerId)) {
			finished.handle.releasePointerCapture(finished.pointerId);
		}
	}
	function moveDrag(evt) {
		if (!drag || evt.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
		const dx = evt.clientX - drag.x, dy = evt.clientY - drag.y;
		// タップや指先のわずかな揺れでは、中央表示から位置を切り替えない。
		if (!drag.moved && Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) < 4) return;
		drag.moved = true;
		drag.content.classList.add('tooltip-dragging');
		placeContent(drag.content, drag.left + dx, drag.top + dy, drag.rect);
	}
	function closeContents() {
		endDrag();
		contents.forEach(content => {content.style.display = 'none';});
		activeContent = null;
		if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
	}
	contents.forEach(content => {
		initialPositions.set(content, {left:content.style.left, top:content.style.top, transform:content.style.transform});
		// 全ての説明に専用のウィンドウバーを追加する。
		const handle = d.createElement('div');
		handle.className = 'tooltip-drag-bar tooltip-drag-handle';
		handle.setAttribute('title', 'ドラッグして移動');
		const grip = d.createElement('span');
		grip.className = 'tooltip-drag-grip';
		grip.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
		const hint = d.createElement('span');
		hint.className = 'tooltip-drag-hint';
		hint.textContent = 'ドラッグして移動';
		handle.appendChild(grip);
		handle.appendChild(hint);
		const closeButton = content.querySelector('.tooltip-close');
		if (closeButton) {
			if (!closeButton.hasAttribute('type')) closeButton.setAttribute('type', 'button');
			if (!closeButton.hasAttribute('aria-label')) closeButton.setAttribute('aria-label', '閉じる');
			handle.appendChild(closeButton);
		}
		content.insertBefore(handle, content.firstChild);
		handle.addEventListener('pointerdown', evt => {
			if (drag || !evt.isPrimary || evt.button !== 0 || evt.target.closest('a,button,input,select,textarea,label,[contenteditable]')) return;
			const rect = content.getBoundingClientRect();
			drag = {content, handle, pointerId:evt.pointerId, x:evt.clientX, y:evt.clientY, left:rect.left, top:rect.top, rect, moved:false};
			handle.setPointerCapture(evt.pointerId);
			d.addEventListener('pointermove', moveDrag);
			d.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
			d.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
			evt.preventDefault();
		});
		handle.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', endDrag);
	});
	d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip').forEach(el => {
		const content = d.getElementById(el.getAttribute('data-tooltip-id'));
		el.addEventListener('click', () => {
			closeContents();
			if (!content || !overlay) return;
			const initial = initialPositions.get(content);
			if (initial) Object.assign(content.style, initial);
			content.scrollTop = 0;
			content.style.display = 'block';
			overlay.style.display = 'block';
			activeContent = content;
		});
	});
	d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip-close').forEach(btn => {btn.addEventListener('click', closeContents);});
	if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeContents);
	window.addEventListener('blur', () => endDrag());
	window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
		endDrag();
		if (!activeContent) return;
		const rect = activeContent.getBoundingClientRect();
		placeContent(activeContent, rect.left, rect.top, rect);
	});
});

// 「主なスケジュール」「経済指標」の日付が本日なら today クラスを追加
// ただし「0:00〜7:00」は“前日”にも todayB を付ける
function scheduleDateNodes(root,selector) {
  const nodes=[];
  root=root||document;
  if(root.nodeType===1&&root.matches&&root.matches(selector))nodes.push(root);
  if(root.querySelectorAll)root.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach((node)=>nodes.push(node));
  return nodes;
}
function refreshScheduleDateClasses(force,root) {
  const now = new Date(Date.now()+9*36e5);
  const pad2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

  // --- 日付文字列の生成 ---
  // 当日
  const y = now.getUTCFullYear();
  const m = pad2(now.getUTCMonth() + 1);
  const d0 = pad2(now.getUTCDate());
  const todayYMD = `${y}-${m}-${d0}`;
  const todayMMDD = `${m}/${d0}`;
  const isEarlyMorning = (now.getUTCHours() < 7);
  const dateKey = todayYMD+'|'+(isEarlyMorning?'early':'day');
  if(!root&&!force&&nkScheduleDateKey===dateKey) return;
  if(!root)nkScheduleDateKey=dateKey;
  // 前日
  const prevDate = new Date(now);
  prevDate.setUTCDate(now.getUTCDate() - 1);
  const py = prevDate.getUTCFullYear();
  const pm = pad2(prevDate.getUTCMonth() + 1);
  const pd = pad2(prevDate.getUTCDate());
  const prevYMD = `${py}-${pm}-${pd}`;
  const prevMMDD = `${pm}/${pd}`;
  scheduleDateNodes(root,'.day.today,.day.todayB,.day.dSat,.day.dSun,.date.today,.date.todayB').forEach((el) => {
    el.classList.remove('today','todayB','dSat','dSun');
  });
  // --- クラス付与の共通関数 ---
  const applyClass = (dateValue, elementToMark) => {
    if (!dateValue || !elementToMark) return;
    // 当日判定
    if (dateValue === todayYMD || dateValue === todayMMDD) {
      elementToMark.classList.add('today');
    }
    // 前日判定 (早朝のみ)
    else if (isEarlyMorning && (dateValue === prevYMD || dateValue === prevMMDD)) {
      elementToMark.classList.add('todayB');
    }
  };

  // --- 各要素への適用 ---
  // 1) .day time[datetime] の YYYY-MM-DD 比較
  scheduleDateNodes(root,'.day time[datetime]').forEach((t) => {
    const ymd = (t.getAttribute('datetime') || '').slice(0, 10);
    applyClass(ymd, t.closest('.day'));
    // 土日の色分け (dSat/dSun)
    const dEl = t.closest('.day');
    if (dEl) {
      const dow = new Date(ymd + 'T00:00:00').getDay();
      if (dow === 6) dEl.classList.add('dSat');
      else if (dow === 0) dEl.classList.add('dSun');
    }
  });
  // 2) .date の先頭5文字(MM/DD)比較
  scheduleDateNodes(root,".date").forEach((el) => {
    const textMMDD = el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 5);
    applyClass(textMMDD, el);
  });
  // 3) .day の先頭5文字(MM/DD)比較
  scheduleDateNodes(root,".day").forEach((el) => {
    // すでに 1) で time要素経由で today/todayB が付いている場合はスキップ
    if (el.classList.contains('today') || el.classList.contains('todayB')) return;
    const textMMDD = el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 5);
    applyClass(textMMDD, el);
  });
}
let nkScheduleDateObserver=null;
function startScheduleDateObserver(){
  if(nkScheduleDateObserver||d.hidden||!d.body||typeof MutationObserver!=='function')return;
  nkScheduleDateObserver=new MutationObserver(function(mutations){
    const roots=[];
    mutations.forEach(function(mutation){
	  if(mutation.type==='attributes'){
		const root=mutation.target&&mutation.target.closest&&mutation.target.closest('.day');
		if(root&&roots.indexOf(root)<0)roots.push(root);
		return;
	  }
      if(mutation.type==='characterData'){
        const parent=mutation.target&&mutation.target.parentElement;
        const root=parent&&parent.closest&&parent.closest('.day,.date');
        if(root&&roots.indexOf(root)<0)roots.push(root);
        return;
      }
	  const targetRoot=mutation.target&&mutation.target.closest&&mutation.target.closest('.day,.date');
	  if(targetRoot&&roots.indexOf(targetRoot)<0)roots.push(targetRoot);
      mutation.addedNodes.forEach(function(node){
        const element=node.nodeType===1?node:node.parentElement;
        if(!element)return;
        const closest=element.closest&&element.closest('.day,.date');
        const root=closest||((element.querySelector&&element.querySelector('.day,.date,.day time[datetime]'))?element:null);
        if(root&&roots.indexOf(root)<0)roots.push(root);
      });
    });
    roots.forEach(function(root){refreshScheduleDateClasses(true,root);});
  });
  nkScheduleDateObserver.observe(d.body,{childList:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['datetime'],subtree:true});
}
function stopScheduleDateObserver(){
  if(nkScheduleDateObserver){try{nkScheduleDateObserver.disconnect();}catch(e){}nkScheduleDateObserver=null;}
}
