function move(fromId,toRefId,after){
    var from=d.getElementById(fromId);
    var ref=toRefId.charAt(0)==='#'?d.querySelector(toRefId):d.getElementById(toRefId);
    if(from&&ref)place(from,ref.parentNode,after?ref.nextSibling:ref);
}
function appendTo(fromId,toId){place(d.getElementById(fromId),d.getElementById(toId),null);}
function showAndMove(id,toSel){
    var el=d.getElementById(id),to=d.querySelector(toSel);
    if(el&&to){place(el,to.parentNode,to.nextSibling);if(el.style.display!=='block')el.style.display='block';}
}
function showById(id){var el=d.getElementById(id);if(el&&el.style.display)el.style.display='';}
function hideById(id){var el=d.getElementById(id);if(el&&el.style.display!=='none')el.style.display='none';}
function sameParent(id,ref){
    var el=d.getElementById(id);
    return !el||!ref||el.parentNode===ref.parentNode;
}
function layoutMatches(isSM){
    var ad=d.getElementById('AD_top_280');
    var links=isSM?d.querySelector('#navArea nav .inner'):ad;
    var news=isSM?ad:d.getElementById('sideNEWShr');
    var events=d.getElementById(isSM?'newsDIV':'eveLINK');
    return sameParent('linkRANK',links)&&sameParent('linkNIKKEI',links)&&
        sameParent('sideNEWS',news)&&sameParent('eveNEW',events)&&
        sameParent('eveDIV',events)&&sameParent('eveAD',events);
}
function moveLayout() {
	const body1 = d.getElementById('body1');
	const topmenu = d.getElementById('topmenu');
	if (!body1 || !topmenu) return false;
	if (body1.getBoundingClientRect().width <= 0) return false;
	const isSM = smallScreen ? smallScreen.matches : getWidthPx(body1) === 728;
	const needsMove = lastView !== (isSM ? 'SM' : 'PC') || !layoutMatches(isSM);
	repairParentsOnly = lastView === (isSM ? 'SM' : 'PC');
	try {
	if (isSM && needsMove) {	// --- SMレイアウト ---
		move('sideNEWS',    'AD_top_280', true);
		move('AD_side0_250','AD_top_280', true);//02_side_top_250
		move('eveNEW', 'newsDIV', false);
		move('eveDIV', 'newsDIV', false);
		move('eveAD' , 'newsDIV', false);
		move('sideSUKE',         'sideBottom', true);
		appendTo('sideRANK',     'sideBottom');
		appendTo('AD_side2_250', 'sideBottom');	//22_side_mid_250
		appendTo('AD_side2_600', 'sideBottom');	//21_side_mid_600
		appendTo('AD_side3_600', 'sideBottom');	//23_side_btm_600
		showAndMove('linkNIKKEI', '#navArea nav .inner');
		showAndMove('linkRANK'  , '#navArea nav .inner');
		move('footGlink',         '#navArea nav .inner', true);
		move('bottom', 'footer', false);
		hideById('AD_side1_250');				//03_side2_top_250
		hideById('AD_side4_1050');				//24_side_btm_1050
		lastView = 'SM';
	} else if (!isSM && needsMove) {//--- PCレイアウト ---
		showById('AD_side1_250');				//03_side2_top_250
		showById('AD_side4_1050');				//24_side_btm_1050
		move('linkRANK',   'AD_top_280', false);
		move('linkNIKKEI', 'AD_top_280', false);
		move('eveNEW', 'eveLINK', false);
		move('eveDIV', 'eveLINK', false);
		move('eveAD',  'eveLINK', false);
		move('sideNEWS', 'sideNEWShr', false);
		move('sideRANK', 'sideRNKhr',  false);
		move('sideSUKE', 'sideSUKEhr', false);
		move('AD_side0_250', 'sideEVEhr', true);//02_side_top_250
		move('AD_side2_250','sideRANK',false);	//22_side_mid_250
		move('AD_side2_600','sideRANK',false);	//21_side_mid_600
		move('AD_side3_600','sideRNKhr',false);	//23_side_btm_600
		appendTo('bottom', 'content');
		appendTo('footGlink', 'footLinkTd');
		lastView = 'PC';
	}
	} finally { repairParentsOnly = false; }

	return true;
}

function updateBodyVars(){
    var base=d.getElementById('body1')||d.body;if(!base)return;
    var r=base.getBoundingClientRect(),menu=d.getElementById('topmenu');
    if(r.width<=0)return;
    var values={'--sb-body-left':Math.round(r.left)+'px','--sb-body-width':Math.round(r.width)+'px'};
    if(menu){var menuHeight=Math.round(menu.getBoundingClientRect().height);if(menuHeight>0)values['--sb-topmenu-h']=menuHeight+'px';}
    Object.keys(values).forEach(function(key){if(html.style.getPropertyValue(key)!==values[key])html.style.setProperty(key,values[key]);});
}
function updateFixed(){
    var menu=d.getElementById('topmenu');if(!menu)return false;
    var fixed=(w.scrollY||w.pageYOffset||0)>50;
    if(fixed===previousFixed&&menu.classList.contains('fixed')===fixed)return false;
    menu.classList.toggle('fixed',fixed);previousFixed=fixed;return true;
}
function applyClasses(){
    var cl=html.classList;
    cl.toggle('alignL',prefs.align==='L');cl.toggle('alignC',prefs.align!=='L');
    cl.toggle('fmNone',prefs.position==='N');cl.toggle('fmTop',prefs.position==='T');cl.toggle('fmBottom',prefs.position==='B');
}
function setAlign(value,save){
    prefs.align=value==='L'?'L':'C';
    if(save)prefs.write('SITE_ALIGN',prefs.align);
    applyClasses();resizeWIN();return prefs.align;
}
function setFloat(value,save){
    prefs.position=/^[NTB]$/.test(value)?value:prefs.defaultFloat();
    if(save)prefs.write('SITE_FLOAT_POS',prefs.position);
    applyClasses();resizeWIN();return prefs.position;
}
function reset(){
    prefs.remove('SITE_ALIGN');prefs.remove('SITE_FLOAT_POS');
    prefs.align='C';prefs.position=prefs.defaultFloat();
    w.nkInitialFloatPosition=prefs.position;
    applyClasses();resizeWIN();
}
function resizeWIN(){
    /* 初回同期配置は維持。非表示中の更新は復帰後へ回す。 */
    if(d.hidden&&w.nkLayoutReady)return false;
    if(!moveLayout())return false;
    updateFixed();updateBodyVars();
    if(!w.nkLayoutReady){
        d.querySelectorAll('a.highslide').forEach(function(el){el.setAttribute('data-google-interstitial','false');});
        w.nkLayoutReady=true;
        d.dispatchEvent(new Event('nklayoutready'));
    }
    return true;
}
var requestUpdate=nkFrameOnce(resizeWIN);
var requestPositionUpdate=nkFrameOnce(function(){if(!d.hidden){updateFixed();updateBodyVars();}});
w.resizeWIN=resizeWIN;
w.nkLayout={setAlign:setAlign,setFloat:setFloat,reset:reset,update:resizeWIN,requestUpdate:requestUpdate};
w.addEventListener('resize',requestUpdate);
w.addEventListener('pageshow',requestUpdate);
w.addEventListener('focus',requestUpdate);
w.addEventListener('orientationchange',requestUpdate);
d.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){if(!d.hidden)requestUpdate();});
if(smallScreen){
    if(smallScreen.addEventListener)smallScreen.addEventListener('change',requestUpdate);
    else if(smallScreen.addListener)smallScreen.addListener(requestUpdate);
}
/* Safariのツールバー・拡大縮小による表示領域の変化にも追従する。
   配置はあくまで上のCSSメディアクエリで決定する。 */
if(w.visualViewport){
    w.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',requestUpdate);
    w.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll',requestPositionUpdate,{passive:true});
}
w.addEventListener('scroll',requestPositionUpdate,{passive:true});
resizeWIN();
})(window,document);

// deleteAllCookies
function deleteAllCookies(silent) {
	const currentPath=location.pathname.replace(/[^/]*$/, "");
	const paths=Array.from(new Set(["/",currentPath,currentPath.replace(/\/$/, ""),"/"+(typeof pageName!=="undefined"?pageName:"")]));
	const cookies = document.cookie.split(";");
	for (const cookie of cookies) {
		const eqPos = cookie.indexOf("=");
		const name = eqPos > -1 ? cookie.substr(0, eqPos).trim() : cookie.trim();
		for (const path of paths) {
		document.cookie = `${name}=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT;path=${path}`;
		}
	}
	if(silent!==true)alert("このページのクッキーを削除しました。");
}


// WorldTime
const nkWorldTimeFormatters = {
	"Asia/Tokyo": new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23"}),
	"America/New_York": new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone:"America/New_York",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23"})
};
const nkWorldDateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ja-JP", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",year:"numeric",month:"2-digit",day:"2-digit"});
const nkWorldWeekdayFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ja-JP", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",weekday:"long"});
const nkWorldWeekdayEnFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",weekday:"short"});
function updateTime(targetId, timeZone) {
	const now = new Date();
	// "JST" を指定した場合も、PCのローカル時刻ではなく東京時刻を使う
	const resolvedTimeZone = (timeZone === "JST") ? "Asia/Tokyo" : timeZone;
	const formatter = nkWorldTimeFormatters[resolvedTimeZone];
	if(!formatter) return;
	const timeParts = formatter.formatToParts(now);
	const hour = Number(timeParts.find((part) => part.type === "hour").value);
	const minute = timeParts.find((part) => part.type === "minute").value;
	const formattedTime = `${String(hour).padStart(2, "0")}:${minute}`;

	if (resolvedTimeZone === "Asia/Tokyo") {
		const formattedDate = nkWorldDateFormatter.format(now);
		const formattedDay = nkWorldWeekdayFormatter.format(now);

		const dateElem = d.getElementById("WtimeT");
		if (dateElem) dateElem.textContent = formattedDate;
		const wElem = d.getElementById("WtimeW");
		if (wElem) {
			wElem.textContent = formattedDay;
			const day = nkWorldWeekdayEnFormatter.format(now);
			if (day === "Sun") {
				wElem.style.color = "#f77";   // 日曜
			} else if (day === "Sat") {
				wElem.style.color = "#69f";  // 土曜
			} else {
				wElem.style.color = "";
			}
		}
	}
	const timeColor = getTimeColor(hour);
	const targetEl = d.getElementById(targetId);
	if (targetEl) {
		targetEl.textContent = formattedTime;
		targetEl.style.color = timeColor;
	}
}

function getTimeColor(hour) {
	if (hour >= 7 && hour < 9) {
		return "#6c0";
	} else if (hour >= 9 && hour < 17) {
		return "#da5";
	} else if (hour >= 17 && hour < 20) {
		return "#47a";
	} else {
		return "#999";
	}
}

let nkScheduleDateKey = '';
function updateWorldTime(forceDateRefresh) {
	updateTime("timeJP", "Asia/Tokyo");
	updateTime("timeNY", "America/New_York");
	refreshScheduleDateClasses(!!forceDateRefresh);
}
let nkWorldTimeTimer = 0, nkWorldResumeTimer = 0, nkWorldStarted = false, nkWorldLastResume = 0;
function scheduleWorldTime(){
	if(nkWorldTimeTimer){clearTimeout(nkWorldTimeTimer);nkWorldTimeTimer=0;}
	if(d.hidden||!nkWorldStarted) return;
	let delay=60050-(Date.now()%60000);
	nkWorldTimeTimer=setTimeout(function(){nkWorldTimeTimer=0;updateWorldTime(false);scheduleWorldTime();},delay);
}
function stopWorldTime(){
	if(nkWorldTimeTimer){clearTimeout(nkWorldTimeTimer);nkWorldTimeTimer=0;}
	if(nkWorldResumeTimer){clearTimeout(nkWorldResumeTimer);nkWorldResumeTimer=0;}
}
function resumeWorldTime(){
	if(d.hidden||!nkWorldStarted||nkWorldResumeTimer)return;
	nkWorldResumeTimer=setTimeout(function(){
		nkWorldResumeTimer=0;
		if(d.hidden||!nkWorldStarted)return;
		const now=Date.now();
		if(nkWorldTimeTimer&&now-nkWorldLastResume<1000){startScheduleDateObserver();return;}
		nkWorldLastResume=now;
		updateWorldTime(true);scheduleWorldTime();startScheduleDateObserver();
	},0);
}
d.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){
	if(d.hidden){stopWorldTime();stopScheduleDateObserver();}
	else resumeWorldTime();
});
window.addEventListener('pagehide',function(){stopWorldTime();stopScheduleDateObserver();});

// modern-tooltip replacement for dhtmltooltip
let mTooltip, isTooltipVisible = false, lastMouseX = 0, lastMouseY = 0;
const nkPositionTooltip=nkFrameOnce(function(){positionTooltipCoords(lastMouseX,lastMouseY);});
nkOnReady(() => {
	mTooltip = d.createElement("div");
	mTooltip.id = "modernTooltip";
	mTooltip.className = "modern-tooltip";
	d.body.appendChild(mTooltip);
});
d.addEventListener("mousemove", (evt) => {
	lastMouseX = evt.clientX;
	lastMouseY = evt.clientY;
	if (isTooltipVisible) {
		nkPositionTooltip();
	}
});
window.addEventListener("mouseout", (evt) => {
	if (!evt.relatedTarget) hideTooltip();
});
function showTooltip(htmlContent) {
	if (!mTooltip) return;
	mTooltip.innerHTML = htmlContent;
	mTooltip.classList.add("visible");
	isTooltipVisible = true;
	nkPositionTooltip();
}
function hideTooltip() {
	if (!mTooltip) return;
	mTooltip.classList.remove("visible");
	isTooltipVisible = false;
}
function positionTooltipCoords(clientX, clientY) {
	if (!isTooltipVisible || !mTooltip) return;
	const padding = 10;
	const scrollX = window.scrollX || window.pageXOffset;
	const scrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
	const rect = mTooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
	const winW = window.innerWidth;
	const winH = window.innerHeight;
	let left = clientX + padding;
	let top = clientY + padding;
	if (left + rect.width > winW) {
		left = clientX - rect.width - padding;
		if (left < 0) left = padding;
	}
	if (top + rect.height > winH) {
		top = clientY - rect.height - padding;
		if (top < 0) top = padding;
	}
	mTooltip.style.left = `${left + scrollX}px`;
	mTooltip.style.top = `${top + scrollY}px`;
}

/* tooltip  replacement for micromodal */
nkOnReady(() => {
	const contents = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip-content'));
	const overlay = d.getElementById('overlay');
	const initialPositions = new WeakMap();
	let activeContent = null, drag = null;
	function placeContent(content, left, top, rect) {
		const margin = 8;
		// 固定幅ページを縮小表示するスマホでは clientWidth と表示範囲が異なる。
		const viewport = window.visualViewport;
		const width = viewport ? viewport.width : window.innerWidth;
		const height = viewport ? viewport.height : window.innerHeight;
		const minLeft = (viewport ? viewport.offsetLeft : 0) + margin;
		const minTop = (viewport ? viewport.offsetTop : 0) + margin;
		left = Math.max(minLeft, Math.min(left, Math.max(minLeft, minLeft + width - rect.width - margin * 2)));
		top = Math.max(minTop, Math.min(top, Math.max(minTop, minTop + height - rect.height - margin * 2)));
		// CSS zoom が指定されたページでも、画面上の座標を二重に縮小しない。
		const cssWidth = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(content).width);
		const scale = content.currentCSSZoom || (cssWidth > 0 ? rect.width / cssWidth : 1) || 1;
		content.style.transform = 'none';
		content.style.left = left / scale + 'px';
		content.style.top = top / scale + 'px';
		return {left, top};
	}
	function endDrag(evt) {
		if (!drag || (evt && evt.pointerId !== undefined && evt.pointerId !== drag.pointerId)) return;
		const finished = drag;
		drag = null;
		finished.content.classList.remove('tooltip-dragging');
		d.removeEventListener('pointermove', moveDrag);
		d.removeEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
		d.removeEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
		if (finished.handle.hasPointerCapture(finished.pointerId)) {
			finished.handle.releasePointerCapture(finished.pointerId);
		}
	}
	function moveDrag(evt) {
		if (!drag || evt.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
		const dx = evt.clientX - drag.x, dy = evt.clientY - drag.y;
		// タップや指先のわずかな揺れでは、中央表示から位置を切り替えない。
		if (!drag.moved && Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) < 4) return;
		drag.moved = true;
		drag.content.classList.add('tooltip-dragging');
		placeContent(drag.content, drag.left + dx, drag.top + dy, drag.rect);
	}
	function closeContents() {
		endDrag();
		contents.forEach(content => {content.style.display = 'none';});
		activeContent = null;
		if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
	}
	contents.forEach(content => {
		initialPositions.set(content, {left:content.style.left, top:content.style.top, transform:content.style.transform});
		// 全ての説明に専用のウィンドウバーを追加する。
		const handle = d.createElement('div');
		handle.className = 'tooltip-drag-bar tooltip-drag-handle';
		handle.setAttribute('title', 'ドラッグして移動');
		const grip = d.createElement('span');
		grip.className = 'tooltip-drag-grip';
		grip.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
		const hint = d.createElement('span');
		hint.className = 'tooltip-drag-hint';
		hint.textContent = 'ドラッグして移動';
		handle.appendChild(grip);
		handle.appendChild(hint);
		const closeButton = content.querySelector('.tooltip-close');
		if (closeButton) {
			if (!closeButton.hasAttribute('type')) closeButton.setAttribute('type', 'button');
			if (!closeButton.hasAttribute('aria-label')) closeButton.setAttribute('aria-label', '閉じる');
			handle.appendChild(closeButton);
		}
		content.insertBefore(handle, content.firstChild);
		handle.addEventListener('pointerdown', evt => {
			if (drag || !evt.isPrimary || evt.button !== 0 || evt.target.closest('a,button,input,select,textarea,label,[contenteditable]')) return;
			const rect = content.getBoundingClientRect();
			drag = {content, handle, pointerId:evt.pointerId, x:evt.clientX, y:evt.clientY, left:rect.left, top:rect.top, rect, moved:false};
			handle.setPointerCapture(evt.pointerId);
			d.addEventListener('pointermove', moveDrag);
			d.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
			d.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
			evt.preventDefault();
		});
		handle.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', endDrag);
	});
	d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip').forEach(el => {
		const content = d.getElementById(el.getAttribute('data-tooltip-id'));
		el.addEventListener('click', () => {
			closeContents();
			if (!content || !overlay) return;
			const initial = initialPositions.get(content);
			if (initial) Object.assign(content.style, initial);
			content.scrollTop = 0;
			content.style.display = 'block';
			overlay.style.display = 'block';
			activeContent = content;
		});
	});
	d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip-close').forEach(btn => {btn.addEventListener('click', closeContents);});
	if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeContents);
	window.addEventListener('blur', () => endDrag());
	window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
		endDrag();
		if (!activeContent) return;
		const rect = activeContent.getBoundingClientRect();
		placeContent(activeContent, rect.left, rect.top, rect);
	});
});

// 「主なスケジュール」「経済指標」の日付が本日なら today クラスを追加
// ただし「0:00〜7:00」は“前日”にも todayB を付ける
function scheduleDateNodes(root,selector) {
  const nodes=[];
  root=root||document;
  if(root.nodeType===1&&root.matches&&root.matches(selector))nodes.push(root);
  if(root.querySelectorAll)root.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach((node)=>nodes.push(node));
  return nodes;
}
function refreshScheduleDateClasses(force,root) {
  const now = new Date(Date.now()+9*36e5);
  const pad2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

  // --- 日付文字列の生成 ---
  // 当日
  const y = now.getUTCFullYear();
  const m = pad2(now.getUTCMonth() + 1);
  const d0 = pad2(now.getUTCDate());
  const todayYMD = `${y}-${m}-${d0}`;
  const todayMMDD = `${m}/${d0}`;
  const isEarlyMorning = (now.getUTCHours() < 7);
  const dateKey = todayYMD+'|'+(isEarlyMorning?'early':'day');
  if(!root&&!force&&nkScheduleDateKey===dateKey) return;
  if(!root)nkScheduleDateKey=dateKey;
  // 前日
  const prevDate = new Date(now);
  prevDate.setUTCDate(now.getUTCDate() - 1);
  const py = prevDate.getUTCFullYear();
  const pm = pad2(prevDate.getUTCMonth() + 1);
  const pd = pad2(prevDate.getUTCDate());
  const prevYMD = `${py}-${pm}-${pd}`;
  const prevMMDD = `${pm}/${pd}`;
  scheduleDateNodes(root,'.day.today,.day.todayB,.day.dSat,.day.dSun,.date.today,.date.todayB').forEach((el) => {
    el.classList.remove('today','todayB','dSat','dSun');
  });
  // --- クラス付与の共通関数 ---
  const applyClass = (dateValue, elementToMark) => {
    if (!dateValue || !elementToMark) return;
    // 当日判定
    if (dateValue === todayYMD || dateValue === todayMMDD) {
      elementToMark.classList.add('today');
    }
    // 前日判定 (早朝のみ)
    else if (isEarlyMorning && (dateValue === prevYMD || dateValue === prevMMDD)) {
      elementToMark.classList.add('todayB');
    }
  };

  // --- 各要素への適用 ---
  // 1) .day time[datetime] の YYYY-MM-DD 比較
  scheduleDateNodes(root,'.day time[datetime]').forEach((t) => {
    const ymd = (t.getAttribute('datetime') || '').slice(0, 10);
    applyClass(ymd, t.closest('.day'));
    // 土日の色分け (dSat/dSun)
    const dEl = t.closest('.day');
    if (dEl) {
      const dow = new Date(ymd + 'T00:00:00').getDay();
      if (dow === 6) dEl.classList.add('dSat');
      else if (dow === 0) dEl.classList.add('dSun');
    }
  });
  // 2) .date の先頭5文字(MM/DD)比較
  scheduleDateNodes(root,".date").forEach((el) => {
    const textMMDD = el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 5);
    applyClass(textMMDD, el);
  });

// anchor_offset.js（閉じた後の余白が残らない版）
(function(d){
  var html = d.documentElement;
  var raf = 0;
  var anchorEl = null;
  var mo = null, ro = null, bodyMo = null, modeMo = null;
  var checkTimer = 0;

  // Observerで拾えない変化だけを低頻度で補完する
  var CHECK_MS = 5000;

  function isBottomMode(){
    return html.classList.contains('fmBottom');
  }

  function setAnchorH(px){
    // html.style.setProperty('--sb-anchor-h', (px|0) + 'px');
    var value=(px|0)+'px';if(html.style.getPropertyValue('--sb-anchor-bottom-h')!==value)html.style.setProperty('--sb-anchor-bottom-h',value);
  }

  function requestUpdate(){
    if(d.hidden || raf) return;
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(update);
  }

  // 「画面下端にかぶっている高さ」だけ返す（上アンカーは 0）
  function visibleOverlapHeight(el){
    if(!el) return 0;

    var cs = window.getComputedStyle(el);
    if(cs.display === 'none' || cs.visibility === 'hidden' || cs.opacity === '0') return 0;

    var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    var vh = window.innerHeight || d.documentElement.clientHeight || 0;

    // ★下端に届いてない＝下アンカーじゃない → 0
    if(r.bottom < vh - 6) return 0;
    if(r.top >= vh) return 0;

    // 画面下端(vh)に対して、要素がどれだけ食い込んでいるか
    var inter = vh - Math.max(r.top, 0);
    inter = Math.min(inter, r.height);
    if(inter < 6) return 0;

    // data-anchor-status があれば、閉じ系っぽい文字で 0 扱い
    var s = (el.getAttribute('data-anchor-status') || '').toLowerCase();
    if(s && /(closed|close|dismiss|collapse|collapsed|hidden|off|none)/.test(s)) return 0;

    // 中身が消えて「空の箱」だけ残るケース対策
    var ifr = el.querySelector('iframe');
    if(ifr){
      var ir = ifr.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(ir.height < 6 || ir.width < 20){
        var kids = el.children, ok = false;
        for(var i=0;i<kids.length;i++){
          var kr = kids[i].getBoundingClientRect();
          if(kr.height > 6 && kr.width > 20){ ok = true; break; }
        }
        if(!ok) return 0;
      }
    }else{
      var kids2 = el.children, ok2 = false;
      for(var j=0;j<kids2.length;j++){
        var kr2 = kids2[j].getBoundingClientRect();
        if(kr2.height > 6 && kr2.width > 20){ ok2 = true; break; }
      }
      if(!ok2 && (el.textContent || '').trim() === '') return 0;
    }

    return Math.round(inter);
  }

  function findAnchor(){
    // 既存の検出と同じ：data-anchor-status を持つ要素群
    var els = d.querySelectorAll('[data-anchor-status]');
    if(!els || !els.length) return null;

    // いちばん「見えてる高さ」が大きいものを採用
    var best = null, bestH = 0;
    for(var i=0;i<els.length;i++){
      var h = visibleOverlapHeight(els[i]);
      if(h > bestH){ bestH = h; best = els[i]; }
    }
    return best;
  }

  function attachWatch(el){
    if(el === anchorEl) return;

    anchorEl = el;

    if(mo) try{ mo.disconnect(); }catch(e){}
    if(ro) try{ ro.disconnect(); }catch(e){}
    mo = null;
    ro = null;

    if(!el) return;

    // 変化が取れるときは取る（取れないケースは定期チェックが拾う）
    try{
      mo = new MutationObserver(requestUpdate);
      mo.observe(el, {
        attributes:true,
        subtree:true,
        attributeFilter:['data-anchor-status','style','class']
      });
    }catch(e){}

    if('ResizeObserver' in window){
      try{
        ro = new ResizeObserver(requestUpdate);
        ro.observe(el);
      }catch(e){}
    }
  }

  function update(){
    raf = 0;

    if(!isBottomMode()){
      attachWatch(null);
      setAnchorH(0);
      return;
    }

    var el = findAnchor();
    attachWatch(el);

    var h = visibleOverlapHeight(el);

    // 見つからない場合は 0 に戻す（余白残り対策）
    setAnchorH(h);
  }

  function syncMode(){
    if(!isBottomMode()){
      if(checkTimer){clearTimeout(checkTimer);checkTimer=0;}
      attachWatch(null);
      if(bodyMo){try{bodyMo.disconnect();}catch(e){}bodyMo=null;}
      setAnchorH(0);
      return;
    }
    startPageObservers();
    requestUpdate();
    scheduleCheck();
  }

  // 表示中だけページ全体と配置モードを監視する
  function startPageObservers(){
    if(d.hidden||typeof MutationObserver!=='function')return;
    if(isBottomMode()&&!bodyMo){
      try{bodyMo=new MutationObserver(function(mutations){
        for(var i=0;i<mutations.length;i++){
          var mutation=mutations[i],target=mutation.target;
          if(target.closest&&target.closest('[data-anchor-status]')){requestUpdate();return;}
          var nodes=Array.prototype.slice.call(mutation.addedNodes).concat(Array.prototype.slice.call(mutation.removedNodes));
          for(var j=0;j<nodes.length;j++){var node=nodes[j];if(node.nodeType===1&&(node.matches('[data-anchor-status],ins.adsbygoogle,iframe')||node.querySelector('[data-anchor-status],ins.adsbygoogle,iframe'))){requestUpdate();return;}}
        }
      });bodyMo.observe(d.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});}catch(e){bodyMo=null;}
    }
    if(!modeMo){
      try{modeMo=new MutationObserver(syncMode);modeMo.observe(html,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});}catch(e){modeMo=null;}
    }
  }
  function stopPageObservers(){
    if(bodyMo){try{bodyMo.disconnect();}catch(e){}bodyMo=null;}
    if(modeMo){try{modeMo.disconnect();}catch(e){}modeMo=null;}
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', requestUpdate);
  window.addEventListener('scroll', requestUpdate, {passive:true});

  // 保険：閉じ操作がDOM変化を起こさないケースを拾う。非表示中は停止する。
  function scheduleCheck(){
    if(checkTimer){clearTimeout(checkTimer);checkTimer=0;}
    if(d.hidden||!isBottomMode()) return;
    checkTimer=setTimeout(function(){
      checkTimer=0;
      if(!isBottomMode()){attachWatch(null);setAnchorH(0);return;}
      requestUpdate();
      scheduleCheck();
    },CHECK_MS);
  }
  d.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){
    if(d.hidden){
      if(checkTimer){clearTimeout(checkTimer);checkTimer=0;}
      if(raf){if(window.cancelAnimationFrame)window.cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;}
      attachWatch(null);
      stopPageObservers();
    }else{
      startPageObservers();
      syncMode();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('pagehide',function(){
    if(checkTimer){clearTimeout(checkTimer);checkTimer=0;}
    if(raf){if(window.cancelAnimationFrame)window.cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;}
    attachWatch(null);
    stopPageObservers();
  });
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',function(){if(!d.hidden){startPageObservers();syncMode();}});

  startPageObservers();
  syncMode();
})(document);

// Yahoo URLからコード・種別・ページを抽出（正規化）
function parseYahooUrl(url){
	if(!url || typeof url !== 'string') return null;
	// 国内 Yahoo (新チャート): //finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/XXXX.T/chart
	var m1c = url.match(/\/\/finance\.yahoo\.co\.jp\/quote\/([^\/\.]+)\.T\/chart(?:$|[?#\/])/);
	if(m1c) return {code:m1c[1], type:'jp', page:'chart'};
	// 国内 Yahoo (新形式): //finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/XXXX.T
	var m1 =url.match(/\/\/finance\.yahoo\.co\.jp\/quote\/([^\/\.]+)\.T(?:$|[?#\/])/);
	if(m1 && !/\.T\/(news|profile|history|incentive)/.test(url)) return {code:m1[1], type:'jp', page:'quote'};
	// 国内 Yahoo (旧形式): //stocks.finance.yahoo.co.jp/stocks/detail/?code=XXXX.T
	var m2 = url.match(/\/\/stocks\.finance\.yahoo\.co\.jp\/stocks\/detail\/\?code=([^&\.]+)\.T/);
	if(m2) return {code:m2[1], type:'jp', page:'quote'};
	// 国内 Yahoo (旧チャート): //stocks.finance.yahoo.co.jp/stocks/chart/?code=XXXX.T
	var m2c = url.match(/\/\/stocks\.finance\.yahoo\.co\.jp\/stocks\/chart\/\?code=([^&\.]+)\.T/);
	if(m2c) return {code:m2c[1], type:'jp', page:'chart'};
	// 海外 Yahoo チャート: //finance.yahoo.com/quote/{SYMBOL}/chart/
	var m3c = url.match(/\/\/finance\.yahoo\.com\/quote\/([^\/\?#]+)\/chart/);
	if(m3c) return {code:m3c[1], type:'us', page:'chart'};
	// 海外 Yahoo 概要: //finance.yahoo.com/quote/{SYMBOL}
	var m3 = url.match(/\/\/finance\.yahoo\.com\/quote\/([^\/\?#]+)/);
	if(m3) return {code:m3[1], type:'us', page:'quote'};
	return null;
}

// ポータル別URL構築
function buildUrl(portal, code, type, page){
	if(portal === 'yahoo'){
		if(type === 'jp') return (page === 'chart') ? '//finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/'+code+'.T/chart' : '//finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/'+code+'.T';
		return (page === 'chart') ? '//finance.yahoo.com/quote/'+code+'/chart/' : '//finance.yahoo.com/quote/'+code;
	}
	if(portal === 'kabutan'){
		if(type === 'jp') return (page === 'chart') ? '//kabutan.jp/stock/chart?code='+code : '//kabutan.jp/stock/?code='+code;
		return (page === 'chart') ? '//us.kabutan.jp/stocks/'+code+'/chart' : '//us.kabutan.jp/stocks/'+code;
	}
	if(portal === 'minkabu'){
		if(type === 'jp') return (page === 'chart') ? '//minkabu.jp/stock/'+code+'/chart' : '//minkabu.jp/stock/'+code;
		return (page === 'chart') ? '//finance.yahoo.com/quote/'+code+'/chart/' : '//finance.yahoo.com/quote/'+code;
	}
	if(portal === 'shikiho'){
		if(type === 'jp') return (page === 'chart') ? '//shikiho.toyokeizai.net/stocks/'+code : '//shikiho.toyokeizai.net/stocks/'+code;
		return (page === 'chart') ? '//finance.yahoo.com/quote/'+code+'/chart/' : '//finance.yahoo.com/quote/'+code;
	}
	if(portal === 'nikkei'){

		return (page === 'chart') ? '//finance.yahoo.com/quote/'+code : '//finance.yahoo.com/quote/'+code;

}

function linkSwitch_applyOne(portal,link){
			if(!link||link.hasAttribute('data-no-switch')) return;
			if(isYahooLabel(link)) return;

			var href = link.getAttribute('href');
			if(!href) return;

			// 元のYahoo URLを保存（初回のみ）
			var orig = link.getAttribute('data-ls-orig');
			if(!orig){
				var parsed = parseYahooUrl(href);
				if(!parsed) return;
				link.setAttribute('data-ls-orig', href);
				orig = href;
			}

			// data-ls-orig から変換
			var info = parseYahooUrl(orig);
			if(!info) return;
			var newUrl = buildUrl(portal, info.code, info.type, info.page);
			if(newUrl&&href!==newUrl) link.setAttribute('href', newUrl);
	}

		root=root||document;
		if(root.nodeType===1&&root.matches&&root.matches('a[href]'))linkSwitch_applyOne(portal,root);
		var links=root.querySelectorAll?root.querySelectorAll('a[href]'):[];
		for(var i=0;i<links.length;i++)linkSwitch_applyOne(portal,links[i]);
	}

				var nodes=mutations[i].addedNodes;

	}catch(e){linkSwitchObserver=null;}
	}

(function (global) {

  // -----------------------------
  // パース系
  // -----------------------------
  function parseLine(line) {
    if (typeof line !== "string" || !line) return null;
    var parts = line.split("_");
    if (parts.length < 7) return null;

    var id       = parts[0];
    var perStr   = parts[1] || "0";
    var colClass = parts[2] || "";
    var path     = parts[3] || "/";
    var nameParts = parts.slice(4, parts.length - 2);
    var name      = nameParts.join("_");
    var time      = parts[parts.length - 2] || "";
    var ttRaw     = parseInt(parts[parts.length - 1], 10);
    var ttype     = isNaN(ttRaw) ? 0 : ttRaw;
    var per       = parseFloat(perStr) || 0;

    return {
      id: id,
      per: per,
      perStr: perStr,
      colClass: colClass,
      path: path,
      name: name,
      time: time,
      ttype: ttype
    };
  }

  function parseLines(list) {
    var out = [];
    if (!list || typeof list.length === "undefined") return out;
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      var obj = parseLine(list[i]);
      if (obj) out.push(obj);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // 背景色計算
  // -----------------------------
  function getBgColor(val, e) {
    if (typeof global.colGetPer2BG === "function") return global.colGetPer2BG(val, e);
    var RITU  = 98;
    var BASE  = 90;
    var BASE2 = 100;
    var MAX   = 225;

    var a = Number(val);
    if (!isFinite(a)) a = 0;

    var scale = 1;
    if (e !== undefined && e !== null && e !== 0) {
      scale = 1 / e;
    }

    if (Math.abs(a) / scale < 0.0001) {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    }

    var n = Math.round(RITU * Math.abs(a) * scale + BASE2);
    if (n > MAX) n = MAX;

    if (a > 0) {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + n + "," + BASE + ")";
    } else if (a < 0) {
      return "rgb(" + n + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    } else {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // DOM に描画
  // -----------------------------
  // 数値・順位・時刻は維持し、共通の配色だけ適用する。
  function applyRankColor(element, value) {
    element.setAttribute("data-side-rank-per", String(value));
    if (typeof global.colSetPer === "function") {
      global.colSetPer(element, value, 3);
      element.classList.add("COL_BADGE");
    } else {
      element.style.background = getBgColor(value, 3);
    }
  }

  function build(list, isUp, box) {
    // side_3R側が描画済みのページでは、削除・再生成をしない。
    if (!box || box.querySelector('a.UpdwArap')) return false;

    var items = parseLines(list);
    if (!items.length) return false;

    for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) {
      var it = items[j];

      var href = "//nikkei225jp.com" + (it.path || "/");

      // <a>
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.className = "UpdwArap";
      a.href = href;
      a.target = "_self";

      // パーセント表示部分
      var c = document.createElement("div");
      c.className = "UpDwC";
      applyRankColor(c, it.per);

      var arrow = document.createElement("span");
      arrow.className = "alw";
      arrow.appendChild(document.createTextNode(it.per > 0 ? "▲" : it.per < 0 ? "▼" : ""));

      var pct = document.createElement("span");
      pct.className = "sm50";

/* 診断は有界メモリに保持。GA4は明示した既存ID・抽選ページだけに送信する。 */
var metricsStarted=Date.now(), metricsCurrent={}, metricsTotals={}, metricsHistory=[], metricsQueue=[];
var metricsEnabled=window.AD_METRICS_ENABLED!==0;
var metricsLimit=Math.max(10,Math.min(500,Number(window.AD_METRICS_MAX_EVENTS)||120));
var metricsSampled=Math.random()<Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(window.AD_METRICS_SAMPLE_RATE)||0));
var metricsSent=0, metricsFlushTimer=null;
function metricSend(name, params){
  var target=window.AD_METRICS_GTAG_ID;
  if(!metricsSampled || typeof target!=='string' || !/^G-[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(target) || metricsSent+metricsQueue.length>=300) return;
  params.send_to=target;
  metricsQueue.push({name:name,params:params});
  flushMetrics();
}
function flushMetrics(){
  if(metricsFlushTimer!==null){ clearTimeout(metricsFlushTimer); metricsFlushTimer=null; }
  if(typeof window.gtag==='function'){
    while(metricsQueue.length){
      var event=metricsQueue.shift();
      try{ window.gtag('event',event.name,event.params); metricsSent++; }catch(_){}
    }
  }else if(metricsQueue.length && Date.now()-metricsStarted<15000){
    metricsFlushTimer=setTimeout(flushMetrics,500);
  }else metricsQueue=[];
}
function metricEvent(id, name, extra){
  if(!metricsEnabled) return;
  var rec=metricsCurrent[id]; if(!rec) return;
  var params={ad_slot:rec.slot,ad_phase:rec.phase,ad_layout:isSmartLayout()?'mobile_layout':'desktop_layout',ad_version:'11.6'};
  for(var key in extra) if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(extra,key)) params[key]=extra[key];
  metricSend('ad2_'+name,params);
}
function metricRequest(id, phase){
  if(!metricsEnabled) return;
  var item=itemById[id], slot=item?item.slotName.split('/').pop():id;
  var key=slot+'|'+phase;
  if(!metricsTotals[key]) metricsTotals[key]={slot:slot,phase:phase,requests:0,filled:0,empty:0,viewable:0,renderMsTotal:0,renderSamples:0,viewableMsTotal:0};
  metricsTotals[key].requests++;
  var rec={slot:slot,phase:phase,sequence:adCycle[id],requestedAt:Date.now(),renderedAt:null,loadedAt:null,viewableAt:null,empty:null,size:null,key:key};
  metricsCurrent[id]=rec; metricsHistory.push(rec);
  if(metricsHistory.length>metricsLimit) metricsHistory.shift();
  metricEvent(id,'request',{ad_refresh_seconds:Math.round(refreshMinInterval/1000)});
}
function metricRendered(id, event){
  if(!metricsEnabled) return;
  var rec=metricsCurrent[id]; if(!rec || rec.renderedAt!==null) return;
  rec.renderedAt=Date.now(); rec.empty=!!event.isEmpty; rec.size=event.size||null;
  var total=metricsTotals[rec.key], elapsed=Math.max(0,rec.renderedAt-rec.requestedAt);
  total[rec.empty?'empty':'filled']++; total.renderMsTotal+=elapsed; total.renderSamples++;
  metricEvent(id,'render',{ad_empty:rec.empty?1:0,ad_request_render_ms:elapsed});
}
function metricViewable(id){
  if(!metricsEnabled) return;
  var rec=metricsCurrent[id]; if(!rec || rec.viewableAt!==null || rec.renderedAt===null || rec.empty) return;
  rec.viewableAt=Date.now();
  var elapsed=Math.max(0,rec.viewableAt-rec.requestedAt);
  metricsTotals[rec.key].viewable++; metricsTotals[rec.key].viewableMsTotal+=elapsed;
  metricEvent(id,'viewable',{ad_request_viewable_ms:elapsed,ad_render_viewable_ms:Math.max(0,rec.viewableAt-rec.renderedAt)});
}
window.AD2_DIAGNOSTICS={version:'11.6',snapshot:function(){
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({version:'11.6',startedAt:metricsStarted,sampled:metricsSampled,gaEventsSent:metricsSent,totals:metricsTotals,recent:metricsHistory}));
}};
window.addEventListener('pagehide',flushMetrics);

/* ==========================
 * 1) タイムアウト監視（in‑page）
 * ========================== */
var SLOT_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS = (typeof window.SLOT_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS==='number' ? window.SLOT_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS : 8000);
var slotWatch = {};
function clearWatch(id){
  if(slotWatch[id]) clearTimeout(slotWatch[id]);
  delete slotWatch[id];
}
function startWatch(id, phase){
  clearWatch(id);
  if(!(SLOT_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS>0)) return;
  slotWatch[id]=setTimeout(function(){
    delete slotWatch[id];
    var el=byId(id);
    if(el) el.setAttribute('data-ad-timeout','1');
    if(window.AD_LOG && window.console) console.warn('[AD DELAY]', id, 'phase='+phase);
    // 応答待ちは維持する。広告の消去・再要求・永久停止はしない。
  }, SLOT_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS);
}

/* ==========================
 * 2) マップ構築／EAGER/LAZY（AdList順）
 * ========================== */
var itemById={}, slotsById={}, displayed={};
var adList=Array.isArray(window.AdList)?window.AdList:[];
var adViewable={}, adViewableAt={}, adInView={}, adLastRequest={}, adRequestPending={};
var adCycle={}, adRendered={}, adEmpty={}, adEmptyStreak={}, adStableSince={};
function markAdRequest(id, phase){
  captureSlotDisplay(id);
  resetVisibleTime(id);
  adCycle[id]=(adCycle[id]||0)+1;
  adRendered[id]=false; adEmpty[id]=false; adStableSince[id]=0;
  adViewable[id]=false; adViewableAt[id]=0; adLastRequest[id]=Date.now(); adRequestPending[id]=true;
  var el=byId(id);
  if(el){
    el.setAttribute('data-ad2-version','11.6');
    el.setAttribute('data-ad2-visible-seconds','0');
    el.setAttribute('data-ad2-state','pending');
    el.setAttribute('data-ad2-request-count',String(adCycle[id]));
  }
  metricRequest(id,phase||(adCycle[id]===1?'initial':'refresh'));
}
var EAGER_IDS=[], LAZY_IDS=[];
var eagerCount=Math.max(0, window.EAGER_COUNT|0);
for(var ai=0;ai<adList.length;ai++){
  var item=adList[ai];
  if(!item || !item.slotID || itemById[item.slotID]) continue;
  itemById[item.slotID]=item;
  (ai<eagerCount?EAGER_IDS:LAZY_IDS).push(item.slotID);
}

/* ==========================
 * 3) 定義＆表示（display:none / スマホ除外はスキップ）
 * ========================== */
function keepSlotExpanded(slot){
  if(!slot) return;
  try{
    if(typeof slot.setConfig==='function') slot.setConfig({collapseDiv:'DISABLED'});
    else if(typeof slot.setCollapseEmptyDiv==='function') slot.setCollapseEmptyDiv(false,false);
  }catch(_){}
}
function ensureDefined(id){
  var it=itemById[id]; if(!it) return null;
  if(slotsById[id]){ keepSlotExpanded(slotsById[id]); return slotsById[id]; }
  var slot=googletag.defineSlot(it.slotName, it.sizes, id);
  if(slot){ keepSlotExpanded(slot); slot.addService(googletag.pubads()); slotsById[id]=slot; }
  return slot;
}
function initialLoadDisabled(){
  // isInitialLoadDisabled は非推奨。getConfig が無い旧GPTのときだけ使う。
  if(typeof googletag.getConfig==='function') return !!(googletag.getConfig('disableInitialLoad')||{}).disableInitialLoad;
  return !!googletag.pubads().isInitialLoadDisabled();
}
function showSlot(id){
  prepareInitialSlot(id);
  if(displayed[id] || !canStartInitialSlot(id)) return;
  googletag.cmd.push(function(){
    prepareInitialSlot(id);
    if(displayed[id] || !canStartInitialSlot(id)) return;
    var slot;
    try{ slot=ensureDefined(id); }catch(error){ releaseInitialReservation(id); return; }
    if(!slot){ releaseInitialReservation(id); return; }
    markAdRequest(id,'initial');
    startWatch(id, 'initial');
    try{
      // 初期取得無効時はdisplayで登録後に1回だけrefreshする。
      var manual=initialLoadDisabled();
      googletag.display(id);
      displayed[id]=true;
      if(manual) googletag.pubads().refresh([slot]);
      scheduleProgressiveRefresh(id);
      var el=byId(id);
      if(el) unobserveInitial(id);
    }catch(error){ clearWatch(id); adRequestPending[id]=false; releaseInitialReservation(id); }
  });
}

/* ==========================
 * 4) 可視時リフレ（配信済みは累計表示時間、空配信は要求後 / 従来の段階方式にも対応）
 * ========================== */
var refreshDeadline=0, refreshScheduled={};
var refreshPagePaused=false;
var filledVisibilityObserver=null, filledObserved={}, filledAttributeObserver=null;
function visibleClockNow(){
  return window.performance && typeof window.performance.now==='function' ? window.performance.now() : Date.now();
}
function visibleTime(state, now){
  return state.visibleMs+(state.visibleSince===null?0:Math.max(0,now-state.visibleSince));
}
function reportVisibleTime(id,state){
  var el=byId(id), seconds=String(Math.floor(state.visibleMs/1000));
  if(el && el.getAttribute('data-ad2-visible-seconds')!==seconds) el.setAttribute('data-ad2-visible-seconds',seconds);
}
function pauseVisibleTime(id){
  var state=refreshScheduled[id]; if(!state) return;
  state.visibleMs=visibleTime(state,visibleClockNow()); state.visibleSince=null;
  reportVisibleTime(id,state);
}
function syncVisibleTime(id,visible){
  var state=refreshScheduled[id]; if(!state) return;
  var now=visibleClockNow();
  state.visibleMs=visibleTime(state,now);
  state.visibleSince=visible && adViewable[id] && !adEmpty[id] && !state.finished ? now : null;
  reportVisibleTime(id,state);
}
function resetVisibleTime(id){
  var state=refreshScheduled[id];
  if(state){ state.visibleMs=0; state.visibleSince=null; }
  stopFilledRefreshWatch(id);
}
function rebuildFilledAttributeWatch(){
  if(filledAttributeObserver){
    // A different slot may have changed visibility before this callback turn.
    // Do not discard that notification when a refresh rebuilds the shared watch.
    if(typeof filledAttributeObserver.takeRecords==='function' && filledAttributeObserver.takeRecords().length) onViewGeometryChange();
    filledAttributeObserver.disconnect();
  }
  if(typeof window.MutationObserver!=='function') return;
  var nodes=[];
  for(var id in filledObserved){
    if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(filledObserved,id)) continue;
    for(var node=filledObserved[id];node && node.nodeType===1;node=node.parentElement){
      if(nodes.indexOf(node)===-1) nodes.push(node);
    }
  }
  if(!nodes.length) return;
  if(!filledAttributeObserver){
    filledAttributeObserver=new window.MutationObserver(function(records){
      var affected={};
      for(var i=0;i<records.length;i++){
        var target=records[i].target;
        for(var id in filledObserved){
          if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(filledObserved,id) &&
              (target===filledObserved[id] || (target.contains && target.contains(filledObserved[id])))) affected[id]=true;
        }
      }
      for(var slotId in affected){
        pauseVisibleTime(slotId); adStableSince[slotId]=0; queueRefreshCheck(slotId);
      }
    });
  }
  // Only slot/ancestor attributes: chart children and creative iframe contents
  // never trigger this observer. Existing styles are observed, not changed.
  for(var i=0;i<nodes.length;i++) filledAttributeObserver.observe(nodes[i],{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class','hidden']});
}
function stopFilledRefreshWatch(id){
  var el=filledObserved[id]; if(!el) return;
  delete filledObserved[id];
  try{ if(filledVisibilityObserver) filledVisibilityObserver.unobserve(el); }catch(_){}
  rebuildFilledAttributeWatch();
}
function watchFilledRefresh(id){
  var el=byId(id); if(!el || filledObserved[id]===el) return;
  stopFilledRefreshWatch(id);
  filledObserved[id]=el;
  try{
    if(!filledVisibilityObserver && typeof window.IntersectionObserver==='function'){
      filledVisibilityObserver=new window.IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
        for(var i=0;i<entries.length;i++){
          var target=entries[i].target, slotId=target && target.id;
          if(!slotId || filledObserved[slotId]!==target) continue;
          pauseVisibleTime(slotId); adStableSince[slotId]=0; queueRefreshCheck(slotId);
        }
      },{root:null,rootMargin:'0px',threshold:[0,0.5,1]});
    }
    if(filledVisibilityObserver) filledVisibilityObserver.observe(el);
  }catch(_){}
  rebuildFilledAttributeWatch();
}
// GAMで申告する最短更新間隔と合わせる。未設定時も30秒未満にはしない。
var refreshMinInterval=(function(){
  var ms=Number(window.REFRESH_MIN_INTERVAL_MS);
  return isFinite(ms) && ms>0 ? Math.max(30000,ms) : 30000;
})();
var refreshStableMs=Math.max(1000,Number(window.REFRESH_STABLE_VIEW_MS)||2000);
var emptyRefreshObserver=null, emptyObserved={}, emptyStyleObservers={};
function hasConfirmedEmpty(id){
  return !!(adRendered[id] && adEmpty[id] && !adRequestPending[id]);
}
function emptyRetryDelay(id,state){
  var streak=adEmptyStreak[id]||1;
  var delay=streak===1?60000:(streak===2?120000:300000);
  // Respect a longer configured refresh interval; the backoff is not a cap
  // on publisher settings. Only an actual filled response resets the streak.
  return Math.max(delay,refreshMinInterval,state.interval||0);
}
function stopEmptyRefreshWatch(id){
  var styleWatch=emptyStyleObservers[id];
  if(styleWatch){
    delete emptyStyleObservers[id];
    try{ styleWatch.observer.disconnect(); }catch(_){}
  }
  var el=emptyObserved[id];
  if(!el) return;
  delete emptyObserved[id];
  try{ if(emptyRefreshObserver) emptyRefreshObserver.unobserve(el); }catch(_){}
}
function watchEmptyRefresh(id){
  var el=byId(id);
  if(!el) return;
  if((emptyObserved[id] && emptyObserved[id]!==el) ||
      (emptyStyleObservers[id] && emptyStyleObservers[id].el!==el)) stopEmptyRefreshWatch(id);
  // GPT/another tag may apply the collapse after slotRenderEnded. Observe
  // only this empty div's attributes; do not inspect or alter ad contents.
  if(!emptyStyleObservers[id] && typeof window.MutationObserver==='function'){
    try{
      var styleObserver=new window.MutationObserver(function(){
        if(!adRendered[id] || !adEmpty[id] || adRequestPending[id]) return;
        if(isDisplayNone(byId(id))) adStableSince[id]=0;
        queueRefreshCheck(id);
      });
      styleObserver.observe(el,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class','hidden']});
      emptyStyleObservers[id]={el:el,observer:styleObserver};
    }catch(_){}
  }
  if(emptyObserved[id]===el) return;
  try{
    if(!emptyRefreshObserver){
      emptyRefreshObserver=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
        for(var i=0;i<entries.length;i++){
          var target=entries[i].target, slotId=target && target.id;
          if(!slotId || emptyObserved[slotId]!==target) continue;
          adStableSince[slotId]=0;
          queueRefreshCheck(slotId);
        }
      },{root:null,rootMargin:'0px',threshold:[0,0.5,1]});
    }
    emptyObserved[id]=el;
    emptyRefreshObserver.observe(el);
  }catch(_){ delete emptyObserved[id]; }
}
function updateStableView(id){
  var el=byId(id);
  var visible=!refreshPagePaused && !document.hidden && initialLayoutReady() && adRendered[id] &&
    !adRequestPending[id] && (adEmpty[id] || adInView[id]>=50) && el && !isDisplayNone(el) &&
    !isExcludedByLayout(id) && isInViewport(el);
  syncVisibleTime(id,visible);
  if(!visible){ adStableSince[id]=0; return false; }
  if(!adStableSince[id]) adStableSince[id]=Date.now();
  return true;
}
function clearRefreshTimer(state){
  if(state && state.timer!==null){ clearTimeout(state.timer); state.timer=null; }
}
function finishRefresh(state){
  clearRefreshTimer(state);
  if(state){ pauseVisibleTime(state.id); state.finished=true; state.due=0; stopEmptyRefreshWatch(state.id); stopFilledRefreshWatch(state.id); }
}
function nextProgressiveDue(state, now){
  // 復帰時に過去の予定をまとめて実行しない。消化する要求は最大1回。
  while(state.index<state.times.length && state.started+state.times[state.index]<=now) state.index++;
  if(state.index>=state.times.length){ finishRefresh(state); return; }
  state.due=state.started+state.times[state.index];
}
function refreshDueAt(id,state){
  if(!adRendered[id] || adRequestPending[id]) return 0;
  // Empty responses never generate impressionViewable. Do not synthesize
  // one: retry from the last request, at least 60 seconds apart, instead.
  var empty=adEmpty[id];
  if(!empty && (!adViewable[id] || !adViewableAt[id])) return 0;
  var base=empty?adLastRequest[id]:adViewableAt[id];
  if(!base) return 0;
  // Confirmed no-fill retries have their own schedule, including after the
  // normal filled-ad deadline or the end of a progressive refresh plan.
  if(empty) return base+emptyRetryDelay(id,state);
  var minimum=refreshMinInterval;
  var target=Math.max(60000,minimum,state.interval||0);
  // performance.now() can be fractional while Date.now() is integer-valued.
  // Round the wait upward so the last fraction cannot create a zero-delay loop.
  var remaining=Math.ceil(Math.max(0,target-visibleTime(state,visibleClockNow())));
  var due=state.interval?Date.now()+remaining:state.due;
  if(!due) return 0;
  return Math.max(due,Date.now()+remaining,(adLastRequest[id]||0)+minimum,base+minimum);
}
function queueRefreshCheck(id){
  var state=refreshScheduled[id];
  if(!state || state.queued) return;
  var empty=hasConfirmedEmpty(id);
  if(state.finished){
    // A pending request may finish empty after the normal deadline. It must
    // be able to resume; timeouts or an unknown response never take this path.
    if(!empty) return;
    state.finished=false;
  }
  clearRefreshTimer(state);
  var now=Date.now();
  if(!empty && now>=refreshDeadline){ finishRefresh(state); return; }
  if(empty){
    pauseVisibleTime(id); stopFilledRefreshWatch(id);
    reserveEmptySlot(id);
    watchEmptyRefresh(id);
  }else{
    stopEmptyRefreshWatch(id);
    if(adRendered[id] && !adRequestPending[id]) watchFilledRefresh(id);
  }
  if(!updateStableView(id)) return;
  var due=refreshDueAt(id,state);
  if(!due) return;
  due=Math.max(due,adStableSince[id]+refreshStableMs);
  if(!empty && due>=refreshDeadline){ finishRefresh(state); return; }
  state.timer=setTimeout(function(){
    state.timer=null;
    checkRefreshDue(id);
  },Math.max(0,due-now));
}
function checkRefreshDue(id){
  var state=refreshScheduled[id];
  if(!state || state.finished || state.queued) return;
  if(!hasConfirmedEmpty(id) && Date.now()>=refreshDeadline){ finishRefresh(state); return; }
  if(!updateStableView(id)){ queueRefreshCheck(id); return; }
  var due=refreshDueAt(id,state);
  if(!due) return;
  // slotRequestedが非同期でも、最短間隔の境界では予定を捨てずに待ち直す。
  if(Date.now()<due){ queueRefreshCheck(id); return; }
  // 不可視・応答待ちは保留。可視化／描画／視認イベントで再判定する。
  if(!canRefreshAd(id)){ queueRefreshCheck(id); return; }
  attemptRefreshOnce(id);
}
function scheduleProgressiveRefresh(id){
  if(refreshScheduled[id]) return;
  var plan=window.REFRESH_PLAN;
  if(Array.isArray(plan)){
    if(plan.indexOf(id)===-1) return;
  }else if(plan && typeof plan==='object'){
    if(!plan[id]) return;
  }else return;
  var interval=Number(window.REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS);
  interval=isFinite(interval) && interval>0 ? Math.max(30000,interval) : 0;
  var times=[], configured=window.REFRESH_TIMES_MS || [];
  if(!interval){
    for(var i=0;i<configured.length;i++){
      var ms=Number(configured[i]);
      if(isFinite(ms) && ms>=30000 && times.indexOf(ms)===-1) times.push(ms);
    }
    times.sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; });
  }
  var state=refreshScheduled[id]={id:id,interval:interval,started:Date.now(),times:times,index:0,due:0,timer:null,queued:false,finished:false,visibleMs:0,visibleSince:null};
  if(!interval) nextProgressiveDue(state,state.started);
  queueRefreshCheck(id);
}

function resumeRefreshChecks(){
  for(var id in refreshScheduled){
    if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(refreshScheduled,id)) queueRefreshCheck(id);
  }
}
function resetStableViews(){
  for(var id in adStableSince) if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(adStableSince,id)) adStableSince[id]=0;
}
function pauseVisibleTimes(){
  for(var id in refreshScheduled){
    if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(refreshScheduled,id)) pauseVisibleTime(id);
  }
}
function onViewReturn(){ pauseVisibleTimes(); resetStableViews(); resumeRefreshChecks(); }
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',onViewReturn);
window.addEventListener('pageshow',function(){ refreshPagePaused=false; onViewReturn(); });
window.addEventListener('pagehide',function(){ refreshPagePaused=true; pauseVisibleTimes(); resetStableViews(); for(var id in refreshScheduled) clearRefreshTimer(refreshScheduled[id]); });
document.addEventListener('nklayoutready',onViewReturn);
var viewGeometryTimer=null;
function onViewGeometryChange(){
  // スクロール/リサイズ直後は一瞬の表示で更新しない。判定処理は150msに集約。
  pauseVisibleTimes();
  resetStableViews();
  if(viewGeometryTimer!==null) clearTimeout(viewGeometryTimer);
  viewGeometryTimer=setTimeout(function(){ viewGeometryTimer=null; resumeRefreshChecks(); },150);
}
window.addEventListener('scroll',onViewGeometryChange,{passive:true,capture:true});
window.addEventListener('resize',onViewGeometryChange,{passive:true});
if(window.visualViewport && window.visualViewport.addEventListener){
  window.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll',onViewGeometryChange,{passive:true});
  window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',onViewGeometryChange,{passive:true});
}

function canRefreshAd(id){
  if(!updateStableView(id) || Date.now()-adStableSince[id]<refreshStableMs) return false;
  if(refreshPagePaused || document.hidden || (!hasConfirmedEmpty(id) && Date.now()>=refreshDeadline) || !displayed[id] || adRequestPending[id]) return false;
  var minimum=adEmpty[id]?Math.max(60000,refreshMinInterval):refreshMinInterval;
  if(!adLastRequest[id] || Date.now()-adLastRequest[id]<minimum) return false;
  if(!adEmpty[id] && (!adViewable[id] || !adViewableAt[id] || !(adInView[id]>=50) ||
      Date.now()-adViewableAt[id]<refreshMinInterval)) return false;
  var state=refreshScheduled[id], due=state && refreshDueAt(id,state);
  if(!due || Date.now()<due) return false;
  var el=byId(id);
  return !!(el && !isDisplayNone(el) && isInViewport(el) && !isExcludedByLayout(id));
}
function attemptRefreshOnce(id){
  if(!canRefreshAd(id)) return;
  var state=refreshScheduled[id];
  if(!state || state.finished || state.queued) return;
  state.queued=true;
  googletag.cmd.push(function(){
    state.queued=false;
    if(!canRefreshAd(id)){ queueRefreshCheck(id); return; }
    var sl=slotsById[id]; if(!sl) return;
    clearRefreshTimer(state);
    if(!state.interval) nextProgressiveDue(state,Date.now());
    keepSlotExpanded(sl);
    markAdRequest(id,'refresh');
    startWatch(id, 'refresh');
    try{ var nm=sl.getAdUnitPath?sl.getAdUnitPath():''; logRef(nm,id); }catch(__){}
    try{ googletag.pubads().refresh([sl]); }catch(__){ clearWatch(id); adRequestPending[id]=false; }

/* ==========================
 * 6) OOP（アンカー／インタースティシャル）
 * ========================== */
function resolveAnchorFormat(){
  function logAnchor(src, fp, pos){
    try{
      if(window.AD_LOG){
        console.log('[ANCHOR]', 'source=' + src, 'floatPos=' + (fp || '-'), 'anchor=' + pos);
      }
    }catch(_){}
  }

  function isMobileLike(){
    try{
      if(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) return true;
      if(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1024px)').matches) return true;
    }catch(_){}
    return false;
  }

  function getFloatPos(){
    try{
      var html = document.documentElement;

      // 1) すでに applyFloat 済みなら class を最優先
      if(html.classList.contains('fmTop')) return {v:'T', src:'class:fmTop'};
      if(html.classList.contains('fmBottom')) return {v:'B', src:'class:fmBottom'};
      if(html.classList.contains('fmNone')) return {v:'N', src:'class:fmNone'};

      // 2) localStorage の保存値
      var s = '';
      try{ s = localStorage.getItem('SITE_FLOAT_POS') || ''; }catch(_){}
      if(s === 'T' || s === 'B' || s === 'N'){
        return {v:s, src:'localStorage:SITE_FLOAT_POS'};
      }

      // 3) 未保存時は foot.php 側と同じ端末デフォルト
      // PC=T、スマホ/タブレット=B
      var m = isMobileLike();
      return {
        v: m ? 'B' : 'T',
        src: m ? 'autoDefault:mobile=B' : 'autoDefault:pc=T'
      };
    }catch(_){}

    return {v:'', src:'none'};
  }

  try{
    var fp = getFloatPos();

    // 上部固定メニューなら、アンカー広告は下
    if(fp.v === 'T'){
      window.ANCHOR_POS = 'bottom';
      logAnchor(fp.src, fp.v, 'BOTTOM_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.BOTTOM_ANCHOR;
    }

    // 下部固定メニューなら、アンカー広告は上
    if(fp.v === 'B'){
      window.ANCHOR_POS = 'top';
      logAnchor(fp.src, fp.v, 'TOP_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.TOP_ANCHOR;
    }

    // 固定なしの場合だけ既存の通常判定へ
    if(fp.v === 'N'){
      logAnchor(fp.src, fp.v, 'fallback');
    }
  }catch(_){}

  // ★ readTopH() で window.ANCHOR_POS='top' にする処理は削除する
  // 上メニューあり → TOP_ANCHOR になってしまうため

  try{
    if(window.ANCHOR_POS === 'top'){
      logAnchor('window.ANCHOR_POS', '', 'TOP_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.TOP_ANCHOR;
    }

    if(window.ANCHOR_POS === 'bottom'){
      logAnchor('window.ANCHOR_POS', '', 'BOTTOM_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.BOTTOM_ANCHOR;
    }

    var ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
    var isPad = (ua.indexOf('Android') > 0 && ua.indexOf('Mobile') === -1) || /iPad|Macintosh/.test(ua);
    var isPh  = (ua.indexOf('Android') > 0 && ua.indexOf('Mobile') > 0) || ua.indexOf('iPhone') > 0;

    if(isPh || isPad){
      logAnchor('ua', '', 'TOP_ANCHOR');
      return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.TOP_ANCHOR;
    }

    logAnchor('ua', '', 'BOTTOM_ANCHOR');
    return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.BOTTOM_ANCHOR;

  }catch(_){
    logAnchor('catch', '', 'BOTTOM_ANCHOR');
    return googletag.enums.OutOfPageFormat.BOTTOM_ANCHOR;
  }
}

var pendingOOP=[];
function flushPendingOOP(){
  if(document.hidden || !initialLayoutReady()) return;
  for(var i=0;i<pendingOOP.length;i++){
    (function(job){
      if(!job.due || job.done || job.queued) return;
      job.queued=true;

        job.queued=false;
        if(job.done || document.hidden || !initialLayoutReady()) return;

        job.done=true;

          var manual=initialLoadDisabled();

          if(manual) googletag.pubads().refresh([job.slot]);
        }catch(error){}

    })(pendingOOP[i]);

}
function fireOOPOnce(slot, delayMs){
  var job={slot:slot,due:false,done:false,queued:false};

function createOOP(kind, path, format, delayMs){

}

  return !(/iPad|Macintosh/.test(ua) && document.ontouchstart!==undefined && /WorldStockAlert/.test(ua));
}

/* ==========================
 * 7) IO（同じ先読み距離の枠で共有・ワンショット）
 * ========================== */
var INITIAL_IOS={}, OBSERVED={};
function getIO(id){
  var margin=initialMargin(id);
  if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(INITIAL_IOS,margin)) return INITIAL_IOS[margin];

function observeOnce(id){

  if(!el || isExcludedByLayout(id)) return;
  if(io&&io.observe){

    if(canStartInitialSlot(id)) showSlot(id);

div.radio-group:not(.Fcht) > label:first-of-type {border-top-left-radius:999px;border-bottom-left-radius:999px;border-right:none;}
div.radio-group:not(.Fcht) > label:last-of-type {border-top-right-radius:999px;border-bottom-right-radius:999px;}
div.radio-group:not(.Fcht) > label,
div.radio-group:not(.Fcht) > span > label {width:auto;min-width:0;padding-left:0.6em;padding-right:0.6em;white-space:nowrap;}
/* トグルボタン */
.radio-toggle{appearance:none;position:relative;float:left;box-sizing:border-box;width:60px;height:34px;margin:1px 0;padding:0 5px 0 31px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:#e3dfd5;color:#665f52;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px #0002;font:bold 11px/34px Arial;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;}
.radio-toggle::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:4.5px;left:4.5px;width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff3ba;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #888;transition:transform .15s;}
.radio-toggle[aria-pressed=true]{padding:0 31px 0 5px;background:#fff;color:#62430f;}
.radio-toggle[aria-pressed=true]::after{transform:translateX(26px);}
.radio-toggle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #aa7e25;outline-offset:2px;}
div.radio-group:not(.Fcht)>label:nth-last-child(1 of label:not([style*="display:none"],[style*="display: none"])){border-top-right-radius:999px;border-bottom-right-radius:999px;}

/* ▼ボタンを必ず均等割り（2個でも3個でも余りなし） */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap{
  width:240px;                 /* 全体幅：25%狭めた値（必要なら微調整） */
  display:grid !important;
  grid-auto-flow:column;
  grid-auto-columns:1fr;
  margin:0 !important;
}
/* ボタンはセルいっぱいに伸ばす */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button{
  width:100% !important;
  min-width:0 !important;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding:8px 0;               /* 横paddingを0にして“等分感”を揃える（好みで 8px 6px でもOK） */
  text-align:center;
}
/* 区切り線（固定なし｜上部固定｜下部固定 すべてに線が入る） */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button + button{
  border-left:1px solid #555;
}
/* activeで border-color を青に変える既存指定がある場合の保険 */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap button.is-active{
  border-left-color:#555;
}
/* ラベルをボタンの左に“同じ高さ”で並べる（強制） */
.toggleGrid{
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 140px 240px; /* 左:ラベル幅 / 右:ボタン群幅（25%狭めた幅） */
  column-gap:8px;
  row-gap:10px;
  align-items:center;
  justify-items:start;
}
.toggleGridLabel{
  text-align:left !important;
  justify-self:start;
  margin:0 !important;
  padding:0 !important;
  line-height:1.1;
}
/* 右側（ボタン群）を行頭に固定 */
.toggleGrid .toggle-wrap{
  margin:0 !important;
  justify-self:start;
}

/* ===== FloatMenu (#topmenu) 3パターン：下部固定が必ず効く版（重複なし） ===== */
:root{
  --sb-body-left: 0px;
  --sb-body-width: 100vw;
  --sb-topmenu-h: 62px;
  --sb-anchor-h: 0px;
  --sb-anchor-bottom-h: 0px;  /* 下側アンカー専用 */
}

/* 固定なし：.fixed が付いても殺す（強制上書き） */
html.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu,
html.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu.fixed,
body.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu,
body.fmNone #topmenu#topmenu.fixed{
  position: static !important;
  top: auto !important;
  bottom: auto !important;
  left: auto !important;
  right: auto !important;
  width: auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  z-index:auto !important;
}
/* 上部固定：通常時は自然配置へ戻す（既存CSSがfixedでも事故らない） */
html.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu,
body.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu{
  position: static !important;
  top:auto !important;
  bottom:auto !important;
  left:auto !important;
  right:auto !important;
  width:auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  z-index:auto !important;
}
/* 上部固定：.fixed の時だけ固定（スクロール閾値ロジック維持） */
html.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu.fixed,
body.fmTop #topmenu#topmenu.fixed{
  position: fixed !important;
  top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) !important;
  bottom: auto !important;
  left: var(--sb-body-left) !important;
  width: var(--sb-body-width) !important;
  right: auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  box-sizing:border-box !important;
  z-index:999999 !important;
}
/* 下部固定：常時固定（ここが本命：top を必ず殺す） */
html.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu,
html.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu.fixed,
body.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu,
body.fmBottom #topmenu#topmenu.fixed{
  position: fixed !important;
  top: auto !important; /* ← これが残ると下に行かない */
  /* bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + var(--sb-anchor-h)) !important; */
  bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + var(--sb-anchor-bottom-h)) !important;
  left: var(--sb-body-left) !important;
  width: var(--sb-body-width) !important;
  right: auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  box-sizing:border-box !important;
  z-index:999999 !important;
}
/* 下部固定時：本文が隠れないように下余白（anchor-h=0でもOK） */
html.fmBottom body,
body.fmBottom{
  /* padding-bottom: calc(var(--sb-topmenu-h) + var(--sb-anchor-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important; */
  padding-bottom: calc(var(--sb-topmenu-h) + var(--sb-anchor-bottom-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
}

<script>
(function (global) {
  function buildEvents() {
    // EVE が正しく配列で入っているかチェック
    if (!global.EVE || !global.EVE.length) return;

    var eveDiv = document.getElementById("eveDIV");
    if (!eveDiv) return;

    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();

    for (var i = 0; i < global.EVE.length; i++) {
      var line = global.EVE[i];
      if (!line) continue;

      var p = line.split("_");
      if (p.length < 5) continue;

      var time = p[0];             // 14:00 or 12/10 など
      var cat1 = p[1];             // 株式市場
      var cat2 = p[2];             // 後場OPEN
      var area = p[3];             // タグが入っていてもOK
      var slug = (p[4] || "").trim();  // china or ""

      // デイリーデータ判定（時間に / が入っているか）
      var isDaily = (time.indexOf("/") !== -1);

      var eve = document.createElement("div");
      eve.className = isDaily ? "eve day" : "eve";

      var tt = document.createElement("tt");
      tt.textContent = time;
      eve.appendChild(tt);
      eve.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" "));

      var span = document.createElement("span");
      span.className = "eve2";

      // 「市場休日」が入っていたら eve2 holiday にする
      var hay = [cat1, cat2, area].join(" ");
      if (hay.indexOf("市場休日") !== -1) {
        span.className += " holiday";
      }

      var html = "";

      if (slug) {
        var url = "//nikkei225jp.com/" + encodeURIComponent(slug) + "/";
        html += '<a href="' + url + '" target="_self">' + area + '</a>';
      } else {
        html += area;
      }
      html += " " + cat1 + " " + cat2;

      span.innerHTML = html; // タグをエスケープしない
      eve.appendChild(span);
      frag.appendChild(eve);
    }

    eveDiv.appendChild(frag);
  }

  // DOM と EVE が揃うまで少しだけ待つ
  var retry = 0;
  var maxRetry = 50;

  function tryBuild() {
    if (global.EVE && global.EVE.length && document.getElementById("eveDIV")) {
      buildEvents();
    } else if (retry < maxRetry) {
      retry++;
      setTimeout(tryBuild, 100);
    } else {
      // ここまで来たら EVE が定義されていないか eveDIV が無い想定
      if (global.console && console.warn) {
        console.warn("EVE events not built (EVE or eveDIV missing)");
      }
    }
  }

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(tryBuild);
})(window);

<script>
(function (global) {

  // -----------------------------
  // パース系
  // -----------------------------
  function parseLine(line) {
    if (typeof line !== "string" || !line) return null;
    var parts = line.split("_");
    if (parts.length < 7) return null;

    var id       = parts[0];
    var perStr   = parts[1] || "0";
    var colClass = parts[2] || "";
    var path     = parts[3] || "/";
    var nameParts = parts.slice(4, parts.length - 2);
    var name      = nameParts.join("_");
    var time      = parts[parts.length - 2] || "";
    var ttRaw     = parseInt(parts[parts.length - 1], 10);
    var ttype     = isNaN(ttRaw) ? 0 : ttRaw;
    var per       = parseFloat(perStr) || 0;

    return {
      id: id,
      per: per,
      perStr: perStr,
      colClass: colClass,
      path: path,
      name: name,
      time: time,
      ttype: ttype
    };
  }

  function parseLines(list) {
    var out = [];
    if (!list || typeof list.length === "undefined") return out;
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      var obj = parseLine(list[i]);
      if (obj) out.push(obj);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // 背景色計算
  // -----------------------------
  function getBgColor(val, e) {
    // Color.js の保存済み配色を優先。未読込のページは従来色を使用する。
    if (typeof global.colGetPer2BG === "function") {
      return global.colGetPer2BG(val, e);
    }

    var RITU  = 98;
    var BASE  = 90;
    var BASE2 = 100;
    var MAX   = 225;

    var a = Number(val);
    if (!isFinite(a)) a = 0;

    var scale = 1;
    if (e !== undefined && e !== null && e !== 0) {
      scale = 1 / e;
    }

    if (Math.abs(a) / scale < 0.0001) {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    }

    var n = Math.round(RITU * Math.abs(a) * scale + BASE2);
    if (n > MAX) n = MAX;

    if (a > 0) {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + n + "," + BASE + ")";
    } else if (a < 0) {
      return "rgb(" + n + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    } else {
      return "rgb(" + BASE + "," + BASE + "," + BASE + ")";
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // DOM に描画
  // -----------------------------
  function build(list, isUp, box) {
    if (!box) return;

    var items = parseLines(list);
    if (!items.length) return;

    // 既存の a.UpdwArap を削除
    var olds = box.querySelectorAll("a.UpdwArap");
    for (var i = 0; i < olds.length; i++) {
      var el = olds[i];
      if (el && el.parentNode) {
        el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
      }
    }

    var arrowText = isUp ? "▲" : "▼";

    for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) {
      var it = items[j];

      var href = "//nikkei225jp.com" + (it.path || "/");

      // <a>
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.className = "UpdwArap";
      a.href = href;
      a.target = "_self";

      // パーセント表示部分
      var c = document.createElement("div");

function deleteAllCookies(silent) {
	const currentPath=location.pathname.replace(/[^/]*$/, "");
	const paths=Array.from(new Set(["/",currentPath,currentPath.replace(/\/$/, ""),"/"+(typeof pageName!=="undefined"?pageName:"")]));
	const cookies = document.cookie.split(";");
	for (const cookie of cookies) {
		const eqPos = cookie.indexOf("=");
		const name = eqPos > -1 ? cookie.substr(0, eqPos).trim() : cookie.trim();
		for (const path of paths) {
		document.cookie = `${name}=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT;path=${path}`;
		}
	}
	if(silent!==true)alert("このページのクッキーを削除しました。");
}


// WorldTime
const nkWorldTimeFormatters = {
	"Asia/Tokyo": new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23"}),
	"America/New_York": new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {timeZone:"America/New_York",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hourCycle:"h23"})
};
const nkWorldDateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ja-JP", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",year:"numeric",month:"2-digit",day:"2-digit"});
const nkWorldWeekdayFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ja-JP", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",weekday:"long"});
const nkWorldWeekdayEnFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {timeZone:"Asia/Tokyo",weekday:"short"});
function updateTime(targetId, timeZone) {
	const now = new Date();
	// "JST" を指定した場合も、PCのローカル時刻ではなく東京時刻を使う
	const resolvedTimeZone = (timeZone === "JST") ? "Asia/Tokyo" : timeZone;
	const formatter = nkWorldTimeFormatters[resolvedTimeZone];
	if(!formatter) return;
	const timeParts = formatter.formatToParts(now);
	const hour = Number(timeParts.find((part) => part.type === "hour").value);
	const minute = timeParts.find((part) => part.type === "minute").value;
	const formattedTime = `${String(hour).padStart(2, "0")}:${minute}`;

	if (resolvedTimeZone === "Asia/Tokyo") {
		const formattedDate = nkWorldDateFormatter.format(now);
		const formattedDay = nkWorldWeekdayFormatter.format(now);

		const dateElem = d.getElementById("WtimeT");
		if (dateElem) dateElem.textContent = formattedDate;
		const wElem = d.getElementById("WtimeW");
		if (wElem) {
			wElem.textContent = formattedDay;
			const day = nkWorldWeekdayEnFormatter.format(now);
			if (day === "Sun") {
				wElem.style.color = "#f77";   // 日曜
			} else if (day === "Sat") {
				wElem.style.color = "#69f";  // 土曜
			} else {
				wElem.style.color = "";
			}
		}
	}
	const timeColor = getTimeColor(hour);
	const targetEl = d.getElementById(targetId);
	if (targetEl) {
		targetEl.textContent = formattedTime;
		targetEl.style.color = timeColor;
	}
}

function getTimeColor(hour) {
	if (hour >= 7 && hour < 9) {
		return "#6c0";
	} else if (hour >= 9 && hour < 17) {
		return "#da5";
	} else if (hour >= 17 && hour < 20) {
		return "#47a";
	} else {
		return "#999";
	}
}

// modern-tooltip replacement for dhtmltooltip
let mTooltip, isTooltipVisible = false, lastMouseX = 0, lastMouseY = 0;

nkOnReady(() => {

function showTooltip(htmlContent) {

function hideTooltip() {

function positionTooltipCoords(clientX, clientY) {
	if (!isTooltipVisible || !mTooltip) return;
	const padding = 10;
	const scrollX = window.scrollX || window.pageXOffset;
	const scrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
	const rect = mTooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
	const winW = window.innerWidth;
	const winH = window.innerHeight;
	let left = clientX + padding;
	let top = clientY + padding;
	if (left + rect.width > winW) {
		left = clientX - rect.width - padding;
		if (left < 0) left = padding;
	}
	if (top + rect.height > winH) {
		top = clientY - rect.height - padding;
		if (top < 0) top = padding;
	}
	mTooltip.style.left = `${left + scrollX}px`;
	mTooltip.style.top = `${top + scrollY}px`;
}

/* tooltip  replacement for micromodal */
nkOnReady(() => {
	const contents = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip-content'));
	const overlay = d.getElementById('overlay');
	const initialPositions = new WeakMap();
	let activeContent = null, drag = null;
	function placeContent(content, left, top, rect) {
		const margin = 8;
		// 固定幅ページを縮小表示するスマホでは clientWidth と表示範囲が異なる。
		const viewport = window.visualViewport;
		const width = viewport ? viewport.width : window.innerWidth;
		const height = viewport ? viewport.height : window.innerHeight;
		const minLeft = (viewport ? viewport.offsetLeft : 0) + margin;
		const minTop = (viewport ? viewport.offsetTop : 0) + margin;
		left = Math.max(minLeft, Math.min(left, Math.max(minLeft, minLeft + width - rect.width - margin * 2)));
		top = Math.max(minTop, Math.min(top, Math.max(minTop, minTop + height - rect.height - margin * 2)));
		// CSS zoom が指定されたページでも、画面上の座標を二重に縮小しない。
		const cssWidth = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(content).width);
		const scale = content.currentCSSZoom || (cssWidth > 0 ? rect.width / cssWidth : 1) || 1;
		content.style.transform = 'none';
		content.style.left = left / scale + 'px';
		content.style.top = top / scale + 'px';
		return {left, top};
	}
	function endDrag(evt) {
		if (!drag || (evt && evt.pointerId !== undefined && evt.pointerId !== drag.pointerId)) return;
		const finished = drag;
		drag = null;
		finished.content.classList.remove('tooltip-dragging');
		d.removeEventListener('pointermove', moveDrag);
		d.removeEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
		d.removeEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
		if (finished.handle.hasPointerCapture(finished.pointerId)) {
			finished.handle.releasePointerCapture(finished.pointerId);
		}
	}
	function moveDrag(evt) {
		if (!drag || evt.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
		const dx = evt.clientX - drag.x, dy = evt.clientY - drag.y;
		// タップや指先のわずかな揺れでは、中央表示から位置を切り替えない。
		if (!drag.moved && Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) < 4) return;
		drag.moved = true;
		drag.content.classList.add('tooltip-dragging');
		placeContent(drag.content, drag.left + dx, drag.top + dy, drag.rect);
	}
	function closeContents() {
		endDrag();
		contents.forEach(content => {content.style.display = 'none';});
		activeContent = null;
		if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
	}
	contents.forEach(content => {
		initialPositions.set(content, {left:content.style.left, top:content.style.top, transform:content.style.transform});
		// 全ての説明に専用のウィンドウバーを追加する。
		const handle = d.createElement('div');
		handle.className = 'tooltip-drag-bar tooltip-drag-handle';
		handle.setAttribute('title', 'ドラッグして移動');
		const grip = d.createElement('span');
		grip.className = 'tooltip-drag-grip';
		grip.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
		const hint = d.createElement('span');
		hint.className = 'tooltip-drag-hint';
		hint.textContent = 'ドラッグして移動';
		handle.appendChild(grip);
		handle.appendChild(hint);
		const closeButton = content.querySelector('.tooltip-close');
		if (closeButton) {
			if (!closeButton.hasAttribute('type')) closeButton.setAttribute('type', 'button');
			if (!closeButton.hasAttribute('aria-label')) closeButton.setAttribute('aria-label', '閉じる');
			handle.appendChild(closeButton);
		}
		content.insertBefore(handle, content.firstChild);
		handle.addEventListener('pointerdown', evt => {
			if (drag || !evt.isPrimary || evt.button !== 0 || evt.target.closest('a,button,input,select,textarea,label,[contenteditable]')) return;
			const rect = content.getBoundingClientRect();
			drag = {content, handle, pointerId:evt.pointerId, x:evt.clientX, y:evt.clientY, left:rect.left, top:rect.top, rect, moved:false};
			handle.setPointerCapture(evt.pointerId);
			d.addEventListener('pointermove', moveDrag);
			d.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
			d.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
			evt.preventDefault();
		});
		handle.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', endDrag);
	});
	d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip').forEach(el => {
		const content = d.getElementById(el.getAttribute('data-tooltip-id'));
		el.addEventListener('click', () => {
			closeContents();
			if (!content || !overlay) return;
			const initial = initialPositions.get(content);
			if (initial) Object.assign(content.style, initial);
			content.scrollTop = 0;
			content.style.display = 'block';
			overlay.style.display = 'block';
			activeContent = content;
		});
	});
	d.querySelectorAll('.tooltip-close').forEach(btn => {btn.addEventListener('click', closeContents);});
	if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeContents);
	window.addEventListener('blur', () => endDrag());
	window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
		endDrag();
		if (!activeContent) return;
		const rect = activeContent.getBoundingClientRect();
		placeContent(activeContent, rect.left, rect.top, rect);
	});
});
function setumei(){
    for(var x=1;x<4;x++){
        var row=d.getElementById('colSmp'+x);if(!row)continue;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(row.children,function(cell,i){
